definition_zh: 国际主义者；拥护国际主义的人；国际主义者的
definition_en: a person who believes that countries should cooperate and that all people belong to one wider community
core_image: 一张世界地图上，许多只手从不同国家伸向同一张桌子
scene: 一位外交官在会议上说，各国应当放下成见，共同面对气候问题，人们把他的这种立场看作一种信念。The delegate spoke as an internationalist, urging every nation to share one common future.
sceneCN: 这里 internationalist 是「国际主义者」（第 1 个义项：主张各国合作、视全人类为共同体的人）；句意：这位代表以国际主义者的身份发言，呼吁各国共享同一个未来。

pos.zh: 国际主义者；拥护国际合作的人
国际主义的；国际主义者的

derivatives.zh: international 加名词后缀 -ism 构成，义为「国际主义」，指各国合作的信念与原则
internationalist 加形容词后缀 -ic 构成，义为「带国际主义色彩的」
intern（之间）+ national（国家的）构成，义为「国际的」，是 internationalist 的直接词干
national（民族的）+ -ist（……主义者）构成，义为「民族主义者」，是 internationalist 的对立面
international 加 -ale 构成的专名，义为「国际歌」，传播国际主义思想

senses.title: A supporter of world cooperation
senses.definition: a person who believes that nations should work together and that people share one global community
senses.definitionCN: 相信各国应当合作、全人类同属一个共同体的人
senses.example: He was an internationalist who judged every policy by its effect on the whole world.
senses.exampleCN: 他是国际主义者，每项政策都要看它对整个世界的影响。
senses.why: The -ist ending names a person who holds a belief, so the word first means someone who believes in nations working together.
senses.whyCN: -ist 结尾指持有某种信念的人，所以这个词首先指相信各国应当合作的人。

senses.title: A person with a broad global outlook
senses.definition: someone whose interests, loyalties or habits reach beyond their own country
senses.definitionCN: 兴趣、忠诚或习惯超出本国范围的人
senses.example: Her reading, her friends and her travels all marked her as an internationalist.
senses.exampleCN: 她的阅读、朋友和旅行经历都表明她具有世界眼光。
senses.why: A global sense can pass from belief into habit, so a person who reads and travels widely also earns the label.
senses.whyCN: 全球的视野可以从信念变成习惯，所以广泛阅读与旅行的人也能得到这个称呼。

senses.title: The adjective describing such views
senses.titleCN: 国际主义的；持有世界眼光的
senses.definition: described as believing in cooperation between nations
senses.definitionCN: 形容某人或某事信仰国际间的合作
senses.example: The paper takes a firmly internationalist line on trade.
senses.exampleCN: 这家报纸在贸易问题上持坚定的国际主义立场。
senses.why: English lets person nouns with -ist work as adjectives, so the same word can describe a view rather than a holder.
senses.whyCN: 英语允许以 -ist 结尾的人物名词作形容词，于是同一个词可以形容观点，而不只是形容人。

senses.title: A supporter of international organisations
senses.definition: a person who backs institutions such as peace courts or global bodies
senses.definitionCN: 支持国际法庭或全球机构之类组织的人
senses.example: Early supporters of the peace court called themselves internationalists.
senses.exampleCN: 和平法庭的早期支持者自称国际主义者。
senses.why: Belief in cooperation was first voiced by backers of courts and leagues, so the label also names supporters of global bodies.
senses.whyCN: 对合作的信念最早由法庭与联盟的支持者提出，所以这个标签也指全球组织的拥护者。

senses.title: The opposite of a nationalist
senses.titleCN: 与民族主义者相对的人
senses.definition: a label used as the clear counterpart to a nationalist view
senses.definitionCN: 作为民族主义立场的明确对立面出现的标签
senses.example: In debate, the internationalist argues that no country stands alone.
senses.exampleCN: 在辩论中，国际主义者主张没有哪个国家能独自站立。
senses.why: Because the word measures loyalty across nations, it naturally becomes the mirror of nationalist in public debate.
senses.whyCN: 因为这个词衡量的是跨越国界的忠诚，它在公共辩论中自然而然成为 nationalist 的镜像。

intro.en: Internationalist joins inter (between), nation (a people or country) and -ist (one who holds a belief); its root nation comes from Latin natio, meaning birth or a people born together.
intro.cn: internationalist 由 inter（之间）、nation（民族、国家）与 -ist（持有某信念的人）三部分拼成，其中 nation 源于拉丁语 natio（出生、同族之人）。

items.en: Natio means birth or a body of people sharing a common birth.
items.cn: natio 意为出生，或指共有出生的一群人。

items.en: Nation enters French with the sense of a people or country.
items.cn: nation 带着「民族、国家」的意思进入法语。

items.en: English nation names a people or a country.
items.cn: 英语 nation 指一个民族或国家。

items.en: Bentham coins international for law between nations.
items.cn: 一般认为边沁创造 international 一词，指国家之间的法律。

items.en: Internationalist appears to name a supporter of international cooperation.
items.cn: internationalist 出现，指支持国际合作的人。

note.en: Internationalist is a person noun in the inter plus nation family, standing between national and international, and opposite to nationalist.
note.cn: internationalist 是 inter 加 nation 词族中的人物名词，处在 national 与 international 之间，并与 nationalist 相对。

entries.definition: the belief that nations should cooperate
entries.definitionCN: 国际主义（信念与原则）

entries.definition: involving two or more nations
entries.definitionCN: 国际的（涉及两三个以上国家）

entries.definition: a person who puts their own nation first
entries.definitionCN: 民族主义者（与 target 字形对称）

entries.definition: belonging to the whole world rather than one place
entries.definitionCN: 世界主义的；见多识广的

entries.definition: a supporter of worldwide interests over national ones
entries.definitionCN: 全球主义者

entries.definition: a person who works for peace between countries
entries.definitionCN: 和平主义者

normalIntro.en: Split it as inter plus nation plus ist: a person who holds that nations should act between one another.
normalIntro.cn: 把它拆成 inter 加 nation 加 ist：一个主张各国应当在彼此之间合作的人。

normal.en: The suffix -ist names a person who holds a belief, as in artist or scientist.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ist 指持有某种信念的人，如 artist、scientist。

normal.en: The belief itself drops the person ending to become internationalism.
normal.cn: 信念本身去掉指人的词尾，就成了 internationalism。

normal.en: Pair it with spirit, outlook or policy to describe a wide global view.
normal.cn: 可与 spirit、outlook、policy 搭配，描述广阔的世界视野。

normal.en: Its direct opposite is nationalist, which puts one nation above the rest.
normal.cn: 它的直接对立面是 nationalist，把本国放在他国之上。

normal.en: Compare cosmopolitan: the internationalist acts politically, the cosmopolitan lives globally.
normal.cn: 对比 cosmopolitan：国际主义者多在政治立场上，世界主义者多在生活方式上。

abstract.en: Picture hands from many countries reaching for one table.
abstract.cn: 想象许多国家的手伸向同一张桌子。

abstract.en: Picture an office lined with newspapers from every continent.
abstract.cn: 想象一间堆满各大洲报纸的办公室。

abstract.en: Picture a debate chair labelled with a global view of cooperation.
abstract.cn: 想象一把写着全球合作视野的辩论椅。

examples.en: As a lifelong internationalist, she argued for aid across borders.
examples.cn: 作为终身的国际主义者，她主张跨越国界提供援助。

examples.en: The conference brought internationalists from every continent together.
examples.cn: 这次会议把来自各大洲的国际主义者聚到一起。

examples.en: His internationalist outlook shaped the school trade policy.
examples.cn: 他的国际主义视野塑造了该校的贸易政策。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特奈申纳利斯特」——inter 是「之间」，nation 是「国家」，ist 是「人」：在国家与国家之间说话的人。这只是把词拆成音节来记，不是词源考证。

root: 拉丁语 inter（在……之间）+ natio（出生、同族）→ 英语 nation → national → international → internationalist，核心义「主张国与国之间应当联结的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Internationalist starts as a supporter of cooperation between nations, widens to anyone with a global outlook, then works as an adjective, then names backers of world bodies, and finally serves as the opposite of nationalist.
sensesIntro.cn: internationalist 从支持国与国合作的人开始，扩展到任何具有世界眼光的人，再作形容词使用，又指国际组织的支持者，最后成为民族主义者的对立面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands from many countries meeting on one table.
core.cn: 核心意象：多国的手在同张桌上相会。

branches.en: Support for cooperation between nations is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 支持国家之间合作是基本义项。

branches.en: A wide personal outlook widens the word from belief to habit.
branches.cn: 个人的广阔视野把词义从信念扩展到生活习惯。

branches.en: The same label works as an adjective for views and policies.
branches.cn: 同一个标签也能作形容词修饰观点与政策。

branches.en: Backing global bodies and opposing nationalism complete the political field.
branches.cn: 支持国际组织、反对民族主义共同补全了政治义场。

branches.en: The person and the adjective share one core creed about nations.
branches.cn: 人物义与形容词义共享同一套关于国家的信念。

intro.en: Internationalist is assembled from inter-, nation, -al, and -ist, so each piece adds a layer to the meaning.
intro.cn: internationalist 由 inter-、nation、-al 与 -ist 拼成，每一块都为词义添上一层。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter means between, and natio means birth or a people sharing a common birth.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 意为在……之间，natio 意为出生或共有出生的人群。

items.example: The prefix inter- places the action between parties.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 inter- 把行为放在各方之间。

items.example: Latin natio gives the nation part of the word.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 natio 提供 nation 这一部分。

items.example: Nation is the noun base of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: nation 是整个词族的名词词基。

items.example: The suffix -al forms international.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -al 构成 international。

items.example: International is the base of the person noun.
items.exampleCN: international 是人物名词的词基。

items.meaning: a person who holds a belief
items.example: The suffix -ist forms internationalist.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 构成 internationalist。

items.example: The suffix -ism forms internationalism.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ism 构成 internationalism。

items.example: Internationalism is the belief behind the person noun.
items.exampleCN: internationalism 是人物名词背后的信念。

items.meaning: one who puts the nation first
items.example: Nationalist swaps the prefix for a nation-first idea.
items.exampleCN: nationalist 把前缀换成民族优先的观念。

items.example: Cosmopolitan is a Greek cousin of the same idea.
items.exampleCN: cosmopolitan 是同一种思想的希腊语表亲。

definition_zh: 国际化；国际化程度；全球化；本土适配的国际化开发
definition_en: the process of making something international, or the quality of being international; in computing, the design of software so that it can be adapted to many languages and cultures
core_image: 同一张世界地图，被更多的航线、更多的语言同时覆盖
scene: 这家公司把业务扩展到许多国家，办公室里的员工来自不同大陆。Within a decade the internationalization of the firm turned a small local bank into a name known on every continent.
sceneCN: 这里 internationalization 是「国际化」（第 1 个义项：使事物变得国际化的过程或性质）；句意：十年之内，这家公司的国际化把一家小地方银行变成了各大洲都知晓的名字。

pos.zh: 名词：国际化；国际化程度；国际性质
名词（计算机）：国际化开发；使软件可适配多种语言与文化

由拉丁词根 inter- 与 natio 构成的基础形容词，义为「国际的；国际性的」

senses.title: The process of becoming international
senses.titleCN: 国际化：使事物具有国际性质的过程
senses.definition: the act or process of making something international, or the state of being international
senses.definitionCN: 使某事物具备国际性质的行为或过程，以及由此形成的国际状态
senses.example: The internationalization of the student body changed the campus dramatically.
senses.exampleCN: 学生构成的国际化让校园面貌大变。
senses.why: The Latin prefix inter- means between, and natio means a people or nation, so the word literally points to things moving between nations.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语前缀 inter- 表示「在……之间」，natio 表示「部族、民族」，所以这个词字面上就指向事物在国与国之间流动。

senses.title: Economic and market integration across borders
senses.titleCN: 经济国际化：资本与市场跨越国界
senses.definition: the growth of trade, investment and production that crosses national borders
senses.definitionCN: 贸易、投资与生产跨越国界不断扩大的过程
senses.example: Cheaper shipping accelerated the internationalization of trade in the nineteenth century.
senses.exampleCN: 更廉价的航运在十九世纪加快了贸易的国际化。
senses.why: Once things can move between nations as a habit rather than an exception, the process takes on an economic life of its own.
senses.whyCN: 当事物在国与国之间流动从例外变成常态，这一过程就具有了独立的经济生命。

senses.title: Institutional cooperation between nations
senses.titleCN: 国际共管与合作：多国共同参与
senses.definition: the bringing of an activity, territory or resource under the shared control or cooperation of several nations
senses.definitionCN: 把某项活动、领土或资源置于多国共同控制或合作之下
senses.example: The internationalization of the canal was meant to keep it open to all shipping.
senses.exampleCN: 运河的国际共管意在使它向所有航运开放。
senses.why: The nineteenth century used the word for shared control, so internationalization could mean placing something under many flags at once.
senses.whyCN: 十九世纪的用法指着「共同管理」，因此国际化也可以指把某物同时置于多面旗帜之下。

senses.title: Software localization readiness
senses.titleCN: 国际化开发：让软件可适配多种语言文化
senses.definition: in computing, the design and preparation of software so that it can be adapted to many languages and regions
senses.definitionCN: 计算机领域中，为使软件适配多种语言与地区而进行的设计与准备
senses.example: Good internationalization keeps text, dates and currencies out of the source code.
senses.exampleCN: 良好的国际化开发会把文字、日期与货币排除在源码之外。
senses.why: Software has to behave like a product that can cross borders, so the abstract process became a concrete engineering practice with its own abbreviation.
senses.whyCN: 软件必须像一件能跨越国界的商品那样行事，于是抽象的「过程」变成了具体工程实践，还得了自己的缩写。

senses.title: Cultural mixing of outlooks
senses.definition: the broadening of a person or group toward other cultures and outlooks
senses.definitionCN: 使个人或群体对其他文化与观念持开放视野
senses.example: Years abroad gave her a quiet internationalization of taste and habit.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的海外生活让她的品味与习惯悄然国际化。
senses.why: If a city or a market can be internationalized, so can a person, by taking in habits from many nations.
senses.whyCN: 既然城市与市场都能国际化，个人也可以靠接纳多国习惯而国际化。

senses.title: Adoption of a word beyond its native country
senses.titleCN: 词语的国际传播：从本土走向世界
senses.definition: the process by which a word or usage spreads from its home country to other languages
senses.definitionCN: 词语或用法从原产国传播到其他语言的过程
senses.example: The internationalization of the word soccer followed British trade routes.
senses.exampleCN: soccer 一词的国际传播沿着英国的贸易路线展开。
senses.why: Words travel like goods, so lexicography borrowed the same noun to describe a usage that outgrows its birthplace.
senses.whyCN: 词像货物一样旅行，词典学于是借来同一个名词，描述某种用法走出原产国。

intro.en: Internationalization is a late English compound of the Latin-based prefix inter- and the Latin word natio, with the act-noun suffix -ation added.
intro.cn: internationalization 是英语后期拼合而成：拉丁语来源的前缀 inter-、拉丁语词 natio，再加表示行为的名词后缀 -ation。

items.en: Natio meant birth, descent or a people born together, from the verb nasci, to be born.
items.cn: natio 意为「出生、世系、同族」由动词 nasci「出生」派生而来。

items.en: Nation enters English in the fourteenth century; national and nationality follow.
items.cn: nation 在十四世纪进入英语，national 与 nationality 随后出现。

items.en: The adjective international is attributed to the legal philosophic writer Jeremy Bentham, who coined it for legal use; exact composition date is uncertain.
items.cn: 形容词 international 一般认为出自法哲学作家边沁，他为法律用途造了这个词；确切成词时间不确定。

items.en: The noun internationalization appears in the 1860s, first for the shared control of a territory such as a canal.
items.cn: 名词 internationalization 见于十九世纪六十年代，最初指运河等领土的共管。

items.en: The suffix -ation names the act; the word spreads to business and politics, and its French calque internationalisation is used in computing.
items.cn: 后缀 -ation 表示「行为」；这个词扩散到商务与政治领域，计算机领域则使用它的法语仿译形式 internationalisation。

items.en: Software engineering narrows one sense to mean preparing a product for many locales, with the abbreviation i18n.
items.cn: 软件工程把其中一个义项缩小为「为多地区准备产品」，并以缩写 i18n 指称。

note.en: The look-alike group collects words of the same textbook family; the near-meaning group collects wider processes that travel across borders.
note.cn: 形近组收同一词族里教科书式的成员；近义组收各种跨越国界的更大进程，它们彼此侧重不同。

entries.definition: to make something international or bring it under the control of several nations
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「使国际化；把……置于国际共管之下」。

entries.definition: existing or happening between or among nations
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「国际的；国际性的」，指发生在国与国之间的。

entries.definition: the belief in or practice of cooperation among nations
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「国际主义；国际合作」。

entries.definition: the act of taking a private business into state ownership; it merely looks close and comes from national, not international
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「国有化」；只是拼写相近，词源来自 national 而非 international，含义完全不同。

entries.definition: the growth of worldwide links in trade, culture and communication; wider in scale than internationalization and less tied to nations
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「全球化」，强调世界范围的连接，范围比国际化更广，也较少以国家为单位。

entries.definition: the adaptation of a product or software to one particular language and region; the counterpart of one sense of this word
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「本地化」，指把产品或软件适配到某一特定语言与地区，是国际化某一义项的对偶。

entries.definition: the process by which newcomers take on the culture of a host society; runs one way, unlike internationalization
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「同化」，指新来者接受所在社会文化的过程，方向单一，与国际化的双向交流不同。

normalIntro.en: These hooks rest on the Latin root natio, the real prefix inter- and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子立足于拉丁词根 natio、真实前缀 inter- 以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: inter- means between, so internationalization is what happens between nations.
normal.cn: inter- 是「在……之间」，所以国际化就是发生在国与国之间的事。

normal.en: natio means a people born together, and the same root gives native and nation.
normal.cn: natio 指「一同出生的人群」，同一词根还给出 native 与 nation。

normal.en: -ation marks the process rather than the state, so the word names an ongoing move.
normal.cn: -ation 标记的是过程而不是状态，所以这个词指的是一场持续的变动。

normal.en: The computer field prefers the French-looking internationalisation and the short form i18n.
normal.cn: 计算机领域偏爱法语样式的 internationalisation 以及缩写 i18n。

normal.en: Globalization is bigger in scale; internationalization still keeps nations as its unit.
normal.cn: 全球化规模更大；国际化仍然以国家为基本单位。

abstract.en: Picture one flag slowly becoming a row of flags, each borrowing a little colour from its neighbour.
abstract.cn: 想象一面旗慢慢变成一排旗，每一面都从邻旗借来一点颜色。

abstract.en: Imagine a bank counter whose forms are printed in several scripts at once.
abstract.cn: 想象银行柜台上同时印着几种文字的表格。

abstract.en: Think of a canal shared by many nations, with a different flag on every lock.
abstract.cn: 想象一条运河由多国共管，每一道船闸上都插着不同的旗。

examples.en: The internationalization of the university brought students from forty countries.
examples.cn: 这所大学的国际化带来了来自四十个国家的学生。

examples.en: Rapid internationalization of production moved factories closer to new markets.
examples.cn: 生产快速国际化，把工厂搬得离新市场更近。

examples.en: Engineers treat internationalization as a step before any localization begins.
examples.cn: 工程师把国际化看作一切本地化开始之前的一步。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特乃新来者」——因特网把新来者请进门，各国人员往来，世界就国际化了；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 natio「出生、同族」源自 nasci「出生」，派生 natio、nation；再加前缀 inter-「在……之间」构成 international（一般认为由边沁于十八世纪末为法律用途所造），再加后缀 -ation 构成 internationalization。核心义「在国与国之间」。

sensesIntro.en: Internationalization begins as a neutral process word, then divides into economic integration, shared control, software engineering, personal openness and the spread of words.
sensesIntro.cn: internationalization 起初是一个中性的过程词，随后分化为经济融合、共管、软件工程、个人视野与词语传播几条支线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one map gains more routes and more languages until every border carries traffic.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张地图上的航线与语言越来越多，直到每条边界都有往来。

branches.en: The bare process sense: something stops being purely national.
branches.cn: 素朴的过程义：某事物不再只属于一国。

branches.en: The expansive senses: markets and personal outlooks both open outward.
branches.cn: 扩张线：市场与个人视野同时向外敞开。

branches.en: The control sense: many nations hold one thing at once.
branches.cn: 共管义：多国同时执掌同一事物。

branches.en: The technical sense: software is prepared before it is localized.
branches.cn: 技术义：软件在本地化之前先做好准备。

branches.en: The lexical sense: a word leaves its home country like a traveller.
branches.cn: 词汇义：一个词像旅人一样离开原产国。

intro.en: The word is built from a Latin prefix, a Latin noun and a native English act-suffix; the rest of the family grows from the same stem.
intro.cn: 这个词由拉丁语前缀、拉丁语名词与英语行为后缀拼成；词族其余成员都从同一词干生长出来。

latinIntro.en: Latin natio and the verb nasci are recorded, so only the English date of composition is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 natio 与动词 nasci 都有文献记录，只有英语成词的具体年代不确定。

definition_zh: 内科医生；内科学家；内科专科医师
definition_en: a doctor who specializes in internal medicine, diagnosing and treating diseases of the internal organs in adults
core_image: 不拿手术刀的手，拿着听诊器在成年病人的躯体上仔细检查
scene: 门诊里，一位四十多岁的病人带着反复的乏力和低烧来求诊。The internist listened to his chest, checked his blood tests and sent him for further thyroid screening.
sceneCN: 这里 internist 是「内科医生」（第 1 个义项：以内部器官疾病为专业的医师）；句意：这位内科医生听他听诊胸部，查看了血液化验，又让他去做进一步的甲状腺筛查。

pos.zh: 名词：内科医生；以内科为专业的医师
名词：内科学家；内科专科医师（美式用法）

senses.title: A doctor of internal medicine
senses.titleCN: 内科医生：专看内部器官疾病的医师
senses.definition: a doctor of adult medicine who diagnoses and treats diseases of the internal organs without surgery
senses.definitionCN: 以药物和非手术方式诊治成年人内部器官疾病的医师
senses.example: Her internist ordered blood tests before the surgery.
senses.exampleCN: 她的内科医生在手术前开了血液化验。
senses.why: The German model of the word named a doctor of the internal diseases, so the person is defined by the body region that the specialism covers.
senses.whyCN: 这个德语模型词指的是「专治内部疾病的医生」，所以人是由专科所覆盖的身体部位来定义的。

senses.title: A physician among adults with many complaints
senses.titleCN: 成年病人的综合内科医师
senses.definition: a physician who manages adults with several conditions at once and coordinates their care
senses.definitionCN: 同时处理患有多种疾病的成年病人、并统筹其诊疗的医师
senses.example: As her internist, he kept track of every specialist she saw.
senses.exampleCN: 作为她的内科医生，他跟踪记录了她看过的每一位专科医生。
senses.why: Because internal medicine is broad, the internist often becomes the general manager of a complicated adult case.
senses.whyCN: 正因为内科范围宽广，内科医生往往成了一桩复杂成年病例的总管。

senses.title: A doctor dealing with diagnosis
senses.titleCN: 以诊断见长的内科医师
senses.definition: a physician whose skill lies in diagnosing puzzling conditions before treatment begins
senses.definitionCN: 专长在于在治疗之前弄清疑难病情的医师
senses.example: The team called in an internist when the fever resisted every initial guess.
senses.exampleCN: 初期的各种猜测都没能解释这场发热时，医疗组请来了一位内科医生。
senses.why: Internal medicine grew out of the clinical reasoning needed to decide what a whole body problem actually is.
senses.whyCN: 内科学发源于临床推理：判断全身性的问题究竟属于哪种病。

senses.title: An internalist in abstract reasoning
senses.titleCN: 内学家：研究内部关系和内在含义的学者
senses.definition: in older and loose use, a scholar who studies inner relations or who reads words by their inner sense
senses.definitionCN: 旧时与宽泛用法中，指研究内在关系、或按内在含义解读词语的学者
senses.example: One Victorian polemicist mocked every internist who saw inner meaning in the lines of Pilgrims Progress.
senses.exampleCN: 一位维多利亚时代的论战者讥笑那些在《天路历程》的字行间寻找内在含义的内学家。
senses.why: The Latin stem intern- also meant inward, so the English -ist could once name anyone who looks inside things for hidden relations.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词干 intern- 也有「向内」之意，所以英语的 -ist 一度也能指称任何在内里寻找隐蔽关系的人。

intro.en: Internist is a modern English imitation of German medical usage, built on a Latin stem and the suffix -ist.
intro.cn: internist 是现代英语对德语医学用语的仿造，由拉丁词干加后缀 -ist 构成。

items.en: Internus meant inward or inner, from inter, between or within.
items.cn: internus 意为「内部的、内在的」，来自 inter「在……之间、在……之内」。

items.en: French interne names a resident doctor living inside a hospital; the English intern keeps this meaning.
items.cn: 法语 interne 指住在医院里的驻院医生；英语 intern 保留了这一含义。

items.en: German medical writing of the nineteenth century opposed innere Medizin to surgery, that is, internal diseases as against cuts.
items.cn: 十九世纪的德语医学文献把「内科」与外科学对举，即内里的疾病相对于开刀。

items.en: American physicians coined internist around 1900 to name specialists in internal medicine. The exact coining date is uncertain.
items.cn: 美国医生在十九与二十世纪之交造出 internist 一词，用以指称内科专科医师；确切造词年份不确定。

items.en: The word remains chiefly American; British usage prefers the plainer term physician and the older general physician.
items.cn: 这个词主要流行于美国；英国用法更偏爱朴素的 physician 以及较早的 general physician。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words made with the same intern- stem or the -ist suffix; the near-meaning group gathers neighbouring medical roles.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 intern- 词干或同一 -ist 后缀构成的词；近义组收相邻的医疗角色。

entries.definition: situated inside the body or an organization
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「内部的；体内的」，是 internist 的词干来源之一。

entries.definition: an American trainee doctor in a hospital, or to confine someone; it shares the Latin inward stem but names another role
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「实习医生」或「拘留」；共享拉丁「向内」词干，但指另一种角色，并非内科医生。

entries.definition: the period a trainee doctor or student spends gaining supervised practice
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「实习期」，指受训医生或学生在监督下实践的阶段。

entries.definition: the quality of being internal, a rare abstract noun from the same stem
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「内在性」，是同一词干来的罕用抽象名词。

entries.definition: a philosopher who studies inner relations; it merely looks similar and is not a doctor
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为研究内在关系的哲学家；只是拼写相近，实际是哲学用词，并非医生。

entries.definition: a doctor of medicine in general use, especially in British English
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「内科医生；医师」，是英式英语中的常见说法，范围比 internist 更宽。

entries.definition: a doctor who specializes in the heart and the blood vessels
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「心脏病专科医师」，是 internist 之下的一个细分专科。

entries.definition: a family doctor who treats common conditions for whole families; less specialised than an internist
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「全科医生」，为全家诊治常见病，专科色彩比 internist 淡。

entries.definition: a doctor who performs operations; the historical opposite partner of internal medicine
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「外科医生」，历史上与内科相对的一端。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Latin stem intern-, the German medical model and the real phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用拉丁词干 intern-、德语医学模型词以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: intern- means inside, so an internist works inside the body rather than with a knife.
normal.cn: intern- 是「内部」，所以 internist 在身体内部入手，而不是动刀。

normal.en: The -ist ending marks a person, as in artist and economist.
normal.cn: -ist 词尾标记「人」，正如 artist 与 economist。

normal.en: The model is German innere Medizin, so remember a German label on an American word.
normal.cn: 模型是德语的「内科」，所以记住这是一个贴着德语标签的美式词。

normal.en: An intern is the trainee; an internist is the finished specialist.
normal.cn: intern 是实习生；internist 是学成的专科医师。

normal.en: British speakers more often say physician, American speakers say internist.
normal.cn: 英国人更常说 physician，美国人更常说 internist。

abstract.en: Picture a stethoscope tracing a circle inside the chest, and the circle is where the specialist works.
abstract.cn: 想象听诊器在胸腔里描出一个圆，专科医师就在这个圆内工作。

abstract.en: Imagine a stack of lab reports and a doctor joining the dots before any treatment starts.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠化验单，医生在开始任何治疗之前先把这些点连起来。

abstract.en: Think of a patient at one lamp on the ward round, because the word recalls the doctor living inside the hospital.
abstract.cn: 想到查房时病房里的一盏灯，因为这个词还让人想起住在医院里的医生。

examples.en: The hospital hired two more internists for its general ward.
examples.cn: 医院给普通病房多聘了两位内科医生。

examples.en: An internist finally traced the fatigue to a thyroid disorder.
examples.cn: 一位内科医生最终把疲劳追溯到甲状腺疾病。

examples.en: Before referral, the internist explained how the disease would progress.
examples.cn: 转诊之前，这位内科医生解释了病情将如何发展。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特尼斯」——内部的特尼斯：医生专门在身体「内部」找问题；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 internus「内部的」来自 inter「在……之内」，英语先有 internal、intern；十九世纪德语医学把内脏疾病称为 innere Medizin（内科），美国医生据此后缀 -ist 仿造 internist，意为「内科专科医师」。

sensesIntro.en: Internist always names a person of adult internal medicine; the branches widen from the core specialist to the coordinator, the diagnostician and an older abstract use.
sensesIntro.cn: internist 始终指从事成人内科的人；各义项由核心的专科医师扩展到统筹者、诊断者，以及旧时一个抽象用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stethoscope moves inside the adult body, no knife in hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：听诊器在成年病人体内移动，手中没有刀。

branches.en: The defining role: a doctor of internal medicine.
branches.cn: 定义性角色：内科专科医师。

branches.en: The coordinating role: one physician for many conditions.
branches.cn: 统筹角色：一位医生照看多种疾病。

branches.en: The diagnostic role: reasoning before treatment.
branches.cn: 诊断角色：在治疗之前推理。

branches.en: Both rest on the breadth of internal medicine in adults.
branches.cn: 两者都立足于成人内科的广度。

branches.en: The faded sense: anyone who reads the inward meaning.
branches.cn: 淡去的义项：任何读解内在含义的人。

intro.en: Internist is a Latin stem plus the person suffix -ist, shaped by German medical usage; its modern family clusters around the word internal.
intro.cn: internist 是拉丁词干加人称后缀 -ist，由德语医学用法塑形；现代词族都围绕 internal 一词聚集。

latinIntro.en: Latin internus and inter are recorded, so only the exact English coining date remains uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 internus 与 inter 都有文献记录，只有英语确切的造词年代仍不确定。

items.exampleCN: internus 提供「内部」意象。

definition_zh: 行星际的；星际间的（尤指太阳系各行星之间）；跨行星的
definition_en: existing, travelling, or happening between planets, especially within one solar system
core_image: 一枚探测器从一颗行星的轨道穿出，飞向另一颗行星
scene: 控制中心的屏幕上，一艘飞船离开了地球轨道，向火星飞去。Mission control tracked the interplanetary probe as it crossed the long empty gap between the two planets.
sceneCN: 这里 interplanetary 是「行星际的」（第 1 个义项：发生在行星之间、尤指在太阳系行星之间）；句意：控制中心追踪这枚行星际探测器，看它穿过两颗行星之间漫长的空旷地带。

pos.zh: 形容词：行星际的；太阳系内行星之间的
形容词：跨行星的；散落于各行星的

derivatives.zh: 希腊语 planetes「游荡者」经拉丁语与古英语而来，义为「行星」，是本词的核心词根
由 planet 加形容词后缀 -ary 构成，义为「行星的」
同一前缀 inter- 换成 star 词干，义为「恒星际的」，是更大尺度上的同构词

senses.title: Between planets within one system
senses.titleCN: 行星际的：太阳系行星之间
senses.definition: relating to travel or space that lies between the planets within one solar system
senses.definitionCN: 与同一太阳系中各行星之间的航行或空间有关
senses.example: Interplanetary space is full of charged particles blown out by the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 行星际空间充满了太阳吹出的带电粒子。
senses.why: The prefix inter- means between, and planetary names the planets, so the adjective simply marks the gap between two orbits.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 意为「在……之间」，planetary 指名行星，所以这个形容词只是标记两条轨道之间的空隙。

senses.title: Belonging to travel between planets
senses.definition: describing missions, vehicles or voyages that leave one planet and head for another
senses.definitionCN: 描述从一颗行星出发、飞往另一颗行星的任务、飞行器或航程
senses.example: A solar sail may make interplanetary travel much cheaper.
senses.exampleCN: 太阳帆也许能让行星际旅行便宜许多。
senses.why: Once people imagine moving between planets, the adjective attaches to the vehicles and journeys that do the moving.
senses.whyCN: 一旦人们设想去行星之间移动，这个形容词就附着在负责移动的飞行器与航程上。

senses.title: But not beyond the solar system
senses.titleCN: 仅限恒星系内部的：不等于星际
senses.definition: used to describe space among the planets of one star, as opposed to the far greater distances between stars
senses.definitionCN: 指一颗恒星周围行星之间的空间，与恒星之间遥远得多的距离相对照
senses.example: Watch the prefix: interplanetary is much smaller than interstellar.
senses.exampleCN: 注意前缀：行星际比恒星际要小得多。
senses.why: Because the word keeps the planet as its unit, astronomers use it precisely to contrast with the vaster interstellar scale.
senses.whyCN: 正因这个词以行星为单位，天文学家才用它来与远为广大的恒星际尺度精确对照。

senses.title: Spread across all the planets
senses.titleCN: 散布于各行星的：遍布行星的
senses.definition: existing on or affecting all or many planets rather than one, as in a system of communications
senses.definitionCN: 存在于或影响所有或许多行星，而非单一行星，如通信系统
senses.example: In the novel, a single interplanetary government rules every settled world.
senses.exampleCN: 小说里，一个跨行星政府统治着每一个已定居的世界。
senses.why: If the word can mark the space between planets, it can also mark a whole spanning them, treating every planet as one province of a larger whole.
senses.whyCN: 如果这个词能标记行星之间的空间，它也就能标记横跨它们的整体，把每颗行星当作更大总体的一省。

intro.en: Interplanetary is a modern learned compound: a Latin prefix joined to an English adjective of Greek ancestry, with no older single word behind it.
intro.cn: interplanetary 是近代学术性复合词：拉丁语前缀接上源自希腊语的英语形容词，背后并没有更古老的可借单字。

items.en: The Greek word planetes meant a wanderer, and planetai asteroes meant wandering stars.
items.cn: 希腊语 planetes 意为「游荡者」，行星则被称为「游荡的星」。

items.en: Latin planetae, plural of planeta, learned from Greek, names each wandering body separately.
items.cn: 拉丁语 planeta 的复数 planetae 借自希腊语，逐一个别地指称这些游荡的天体。

items.en: English planet appears in the Middle English period, keeping the image of a star that wanders.
items.cn: 英语 planet 出现在中古英语时期，保留了「游荡之星」的意象。

items.en: Planetary is first recorded in the seventeenth century. Exact dating is uncertain.
items.cn: planetary 初见于十七世纪；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The inter- prefix had long meant between, and astronomy applied it to the spaces and crossings of the planets.
items.cn: 前缀 inter- 早已表示「在……之间」，天文学用车把它用在行星之间的空间与跨越上。

items.en: The adjective becomes common with space travel; its modern setting is the physics of the charged solar wind.
items.cn: 这个词随太空旅行普及；它今天的常见语境是太阳风与带电粒子的物理学。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words built on the same planet stem; the near-meaning group holds the wider scales of space and travel.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 planet 词干构成的词；近义组收更大尺度的空间与旅行用语。

entries.definition: relating to a planet or to planets in general
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「行星的」，是 interplanetary 的词干来源。

entries.definition: a large body that orbits a star and shines by its reflected light
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「行星」，指绕恒星运行、靠反射光发亮的天体。

entries.definition: a small body of rock and ice from which planets are thought to form, a word built on the Greek stem
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「星子」，被认为由之聚成行星的小岩冰天体，同样出自希腊词干。

entries.definition: between the stars; only look-alike, since the unit becomes the star rather than the planet
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「恒星际的」；只是形近，因为单位由行星换成了恒星，尺度远为巨大。

entries.definition: between galaxies, the largest of these inter- scales
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「星系际的」，是这一类前缀尺度中最大的。

entries.definition: between continents on one planet; the same prefix on an earthly scale
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「洲际的」，是同一前缀在人间尺度上的用法。

entries.definition: coming from outside the earth rather than from another planet specifically
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「地球以外的」，泛指地球之外，并不专指另一颗行星。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Greek wanderer behind planet, the prefix inter- and the space vocabulary the word belongs to.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用 planet 背后希腊语的「游荡者」、前缀 inter- 以及这个词所属的太空词汇。

normal.en: Planet meant wanderer, and an interplanetary trip is the wander from one star to the next.
normal.cn: planet 原意是「游荡者」，行星际之旅就是从一颗星游荡到另一颗星。

normal.en: inter- means between, so the word answers: between what? Between planets.
normal.cn: inter- 表示「在……之间」，所以这个词回答：在什么之间？在行星之间。

normal.en: Keep the ladder of scales straight: continental, planetary, interstellar, intergalactic.
normal.cn: 把尺度阶梯记清：洲际、行星际、恒星际、星系际。

normal.en: The word belongs with spacecraft and with the charged solar wind.
normal.cn: 这个词常与航天器以及带电的太阳风一起出现。

normal.en: Interplanetary stops at the edge of one solar system.
normal.cn: 行星际的范围止于一个太阳系的边缘。

abstract.en: Picture a probe leaving the orbit of one planet and coasting toward the orbit of the next.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚探测器离开一颗行星的轨道，滑向下一颗行星的轨道。

abstract.en: Imagine the sun throwing a stream of dust and particles across the whole gap between the planets.
abstract.cn: 想象太阳把尘埃与粒子抛洒在行星之间的整片空隙上。

abstract.en: Hold up a hand with one star on the left and another on the right: your fingers barely span the planets, but the stars are far out of reach.
abstract.cn: 举起一只手，左边一颗星，右边一颗星：手指刚够跨过行星之间，星星却在够不着的地方。

examples.en: The probe measured interplanetary dust on its way to Mars.
examples.cn: 探测器在前往火星的途中测量了行星际尘埃。

examples.en: Engineers call the gap between two planets an interplanetary medium.
examples.cn: 工程师把两颗行星之间的空隙称为行星际介质。

examples.en: A crewed mission between planets would face harsh radiation.
examples.cn: 行星之间的载人任务将面对严酷的辐射。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特扑拉尼特」——因特网铺满各颗「普拉尼特」（行星），行星际就通了；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 planetes「游荡者」→ 拉丁语 planeta → 英语 planet；加 -ary 构成 planetary；再加拉丁语前缀 inter-「在……之间」构成 interplanetary，核心义「在行星之间」。

sensesIntro.en: Interplanetary keeps the planet as its unit: it names the space between planets, the voyages across it, its limit at the solar system edge, and finally a whole spanning every planet.
sensesIntro.cn: interplanetary 始终以行星为单位：它指行星之间的空间、穿越其中的航行、止于太阳系边缘的界限，以及横跨所有行星的整体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow drawn between two dots, each dot a planet.
core.cn: 核心意象：两支点之间画出一道箭头，每个点都是一颗行星。

branches.en: The physical sense: the medium between planetary orbits.
branches.cn: 物理义：行星轨道之间的介质。

branches.en: The engineering sense: vehicles and missions that cross it.
branches.cn: 工程义：跨越它的飞行器与任务。

branches.en: The scale sense: larger than continental, smaller than interstellar.
branches.cn: 尺度义：大于洲际，小于恒星际。

branches.en: Both turn on where the planetary edge is drawn.
branches.cn: 两者都取决于行星边界画在哪里。

branches.en: The spanning sense: a whole that holds every planet.
branches.cn: 横跨义：包含所有行星的整体。

intro.en: Interplanetary is a two-part compound: the Latin prefix inter- plus planetary, the latter itself an English adjective on a Greek stem.
intro.cn: interplanetary 是两段式复合词：拉丁语前缀 inter- 加 planetary，而后者本身是希腊词干上的英语形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin planeta is recorded through Greek planetes; the English adjective is the part whose first date is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 planeta 经由希腊语 planetes 有文献记录；首见年代不确定的是英语形容词这一部分。

items.example: Inter- names the gap between planets.
items.exampleCN: inter- 指明行星之间的空隙。

items.example: Planetes is the wandering star.
items.exampleCN: planetes 即游荡的星。

items.example: Latin carries the Greek word.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语承袭了希腊词。

items.example: Planet is the base noun.
items.exampleCN: planet 是基础名词。

items.example: It forms planetary.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 planetary。

items.example: It forms the variant planetarian.
items.exampleCN: 它构成变体 planetarian。

items.example: It forms interstellar and intergalactic.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 interstellar 与 intergalactic。

items.example: The same prefix on a larger unit forms interstellar.
items.exampleCN: 同一前缀换用更大单位就构成 interstellar。

definition_zh: 相互作用；相互影响；互动关系；配合
definition_en: the way in which two or more things or people affect each other and work together as a result
core_image: 两条溪流在岩壁之间来回碰撞，水花互相推挤着汇成一股
scene: 两位老师在课后交流：学生成绩的起伏，往往是天赋、努力与课堂氛围共同作用的结果。One teacher said that achievement is shaped by the subtle interplay of talent, effort and atmosphere.
sceneCN: 这里 interplay 指「相互影响、相互作用」（第 1 个义项：两个以上事物彼此影响）；句意：一位老师说，成绩是由天赋、努力与氛围之间微妙的相互作用塑造的。

pos.zh: 相互作用；相互影响；互动关系
互相作用；互动（少用）

collocations.phrase: the interplay between A and B
collocations.zh: 甲与乙之间的相互作用

collocations.phrase: the interplay of light and shadow

derivatives.zh: 充满相互作用的；互动性强的（罕见词，由 interplay 加形容词后缀 -ful 构成）
玩耍；扮演；演奏（interplay 所由组成的基础词）

senses.title: Mutual action and effect
senses.definition: the way two or more things or people act on and change each other
senses.definitionCN: 两个或更多事物、人彼此作用并改变对方的方式
senses.example: The interplay between climate and farming shaped the region.
senses.exampleCN: 气候与农业之间的相互作用塑造了这一地区。
senses.why: Inter- marks a link between two parties, and play keeps the picture of things moving and responding to one another.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 表示「在两者之间」，play 又保留了来回活动的画面，所以这一义项就是两方互相对着动作、彼此改变。

senses.title: Working together, mutual influence
senses.definition: the way different parts or people affect one another so that the whole functions well
senses.definitionCN: 各组成部分或人彼此影响、使整体良好运作的方式
senses.example: The team thrives on the interplay of design and engineering.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团队依靠设计与工程的配合而成功。
senses.why: When mutual action is steady and helpful, the interaction becomes a working relationship, so the word names a productive fit rather than mere jostling.
senses.whyCN: 当相互的作用稳定而有益时，互动就变成一种工作关系，因此这一义项强调的是彼此配合、整体顺畅，而不只是彼此较劲。

senses.title: Interwoven appearance
senses.definition: the changing mixture of light, colour, sound, or other qualities as they combine
senses.definitionCN: 光、色彩、声音等不同质感组合在一起时形成的变幻交织
senses.example: The play of shadows is a quiet interplay of light and dark.
senses.exampleCN: 影子的流动是明与暗之间安静的交织。
senses.why: The core image of two streams mingling is visual, so the word can describe qualities that weave into one another even without people or forces involved.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象中两道水流交汇本身就是视觉画面，所以这一义项可以用来形容光、色、声等质感互相缠绕，而不涉及人或力量。

intro.en: Interplay is a transparent English compound of inter- (between) and play, first recorded in the nineteenth century, most often in Victorian prose about science and nature.
intro.cn: interplay 是由 inter-（在……之间）与 play 直接组合而成的英语复合词，一般认为首见于十九世纪，多出现在描述科学与自然的维多利亚时代散文里。

items.en: Latin inter means between or among, and gives English the prefix inter-.
items.cn: 拉丁语 inter 意为「在……之间」，为英语提供了前缀 inter-。

items.en: Play goes back to Old English plegan, to exercise or move about quickly.
items.cn: play 可追溯到古英语 plegan，意为活动、快速移动。

items.en: The sense of play as a staged drama grew through the influence of Latin ludus.
items.cn: play 表示「戏剧」的义项一般认为是在拉丁语 ludus 的影响下发展起来的。

items.en: Inter- begins to form English words directly, and play covers both action and drama.
items.cn: 中古时期 inter- 开始直接参与英语构词，play 同时兼有动作与戏剧两义。

items.en: Interplay is recorded as a noun for mutual action, especially in writing on science and art.
items.cn: 十九世纪 interplay 作为名词被记录下来，表示相互作用，常见于科学与艺术类文章。

items.en: Modern English extends it to economics, biology, design, and everyday talk about people.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到经济学、生物学、设计以及日常谈论人际关系。

note.en: Interplay looks like the inter- family and shares its field with cooperation and interaction words.
note.cn: interplay 外形上属于 inter- 词族，意思上则与「合作、互动」一类词同处一个语义场。

entries.definition: to twist or weave together
entries.definitionCN: 交织；交错缠绕（同前缀 inter-，动作义）

entries.definition: to fit together so that parts hold one another
entries.definitionCN: 互锁；扣合（同前缀 inter-，强调彼此卡住）

entries.definition: to weave things together
entries.definitionCN: 交织；编织在一起（同前缀 inter-，强调编织动作）

entries.definition: the process of acting on and responding to one another
entries.definitionCN: 相互作用；互动（偏过程与动作，中性）

entries.definition: the act of working together towards a shared aim
entries.definitionCN: 合作；配合（偏目标一致的协作）

entries.definition: the extra effect produced when parts work together
entries.definitionCN: 协同效应（各部分配合产生额外效果，偏商业或科学语境）

normalIntro.en: Interplay is inter- plus play: things play off one another until neither side acts alone.
normalIntro.cn: interplay 就是 inter- 加 play：几样东西互相借着对方的劲儿动，谁也不能单独行动。

normal.en: Inter- means between, so interplay happens between at least two things.
normal.cn: inter- 表示「之间」，所以 interplay 至少发生在两样东西之间。

normal.en: The usual frame is the interplay between A and B.
normal.cn: 最常见的框架是「甲与乙之间的相互作用」。

normal.en: Interplay is a mass noun, so say a complex interplay, not an interplay of many.
normal.cn: interplay 多作不可数名词，说复杂的相互作用，而不是「许多相互作用」的复数形式。

normal.en: Play here is the free movement of forces, not a game.
normal.cn: 这里的 play 指力量自由活动，不是「游戏」。

normal.en: Compare interaction: interaction stresses the process, interplay stresses the mutual fit and restlessness.
normal.cn: 对比 interaction：后者强调「过程」，interplay 强调「相互契合又不断变动」。

abstract.en: Picture two rivers meeting in a narrow gorge, each pushing the other.
abstract.cn: 想象两条河在窄峡中相遇，彼此推挤着汇成一道。

abstract.en: Think of a designer and an engineer passing ideas back and forth.
abstract.cn: 想象设计师与工程师把想法来回抛给对方。

abstract.en: See sunlight and leaves making flickering green and gold patterns.
abstract.cn: 想象阳光与树叶交叠，闪出嫩绿与金黄的花纹。

examples.en: The interplay between supply and demand drives prices.
examples.cn: 供求之间的相互作用推动价格。

examples.en: Scientists studied the interplay of heat, pressure and rock.
examples.cn: 科学家研究了热量、压力与岩石三者之间的相互作用。

examples.en: Her paintings capture the interplay of light and shadow.
examples.cn: 她的画捕捉了光影的交织。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特普雷」——因（为）特（别）普雷（通的两人）在互相试探着配合 → interplay 相互配合、相互作用；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 inter（在……之间）+ 古英语 plegan（活动、嬉戏）→ 英语 inter-（之间）+ play（活动），合起来表示「在彼此之间来回作用」，核心义为「两方互动的合力」。

sensesIntro.en: Interplay starts as the mutual action of two forces, then turns into a working fit between parts, and finally describes qualities woven together.
sensesIntro.cn: interplay 先指两股力量的相互动作，再引申为各部分之间的配合关系，最后用来形容光、色、声等质感的交织。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two streams meeting in a gorge and pushing against each other.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条溪流在峡口相遇、互相推挤。

branches.en: Two forces acting on each other is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 两股力量彼此作用是基本义项。

branches.en: Steady mutual action becomes a working fit between people or parts.
branches.cn: 稳定的相互作用就变成人或部件之间的配合。

branches.en: The visual mingling image gives the sense of interwoven qualities.
branches.cn: 交汇的视觉意象带来「交织质感」这一义项。

branches.en: Both a force interplay and a play of light describe things changing each other.
branches.cn: 力量的相互作用与光影流动都描述事物彼此改变。

branches.en: A good fit and a pretty pattern both come from parts combining well.
branches.cn: 良好的配合与好看的花纹都来自各部分恰当地结合。

intro.en: Interplay is built from the Latin prefix inter- and the old English verb play, and it joins a large family of inter- words.
intro.cn: interplay 由拉丁语前缀 inter- 与古老的英语动词 play 构成，并与大批 inter- 词同属一族。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter means between, and it enters English as a productive prefix for words about connection and exchange.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 意为「在……之间」，进入英语后成为表示连接、往来的高产前缀。

items.example: Inter- marks contact between two sides.
items.exampleCN: inter- 标示两方之间的接触。

items.meaning: to move about, to amuse oneself
items.example: Play supplies the image of free movement.
items.exampleCN: play 提供自由活动的画面。

items.example: Interplay is inter- plus play.
items.exampleCN: interplay 就是 inter- 加 play。

items.example: Interact borrows the same pattern.
items.exampleCN: interact 采用了相同的构词方式。

items.example: Interaction is the noun beside interact.
items.exampleCN: interaction 是 interact 的名词形式。

items.example: Interconnect is another inter- compound.
items.exampleCN: interconnect 是又一个 inter- 复合词。

items.example: Interweave keeps the weaving image.
items.exampleCN: interweave 保留了编织的画面。

items.meaning: a giving and taking both ways
items.example: Exchange also carries a two-way idea.
items.exampleCN: exchange 也带有双向的意思。

items.meaning: the activity named by the first part
items.example: The noun head -play makes the compound abstract.
items.exampleCN: 名词中心 -play 让复合词变得抽象。

definition_zh: 使插入；插话；提出（异议）；充当调停者；置于中间
definition_en: to place something or come between other things or people; to say something between other people words; to place (as an objection) before a court
core_image: 一只手伸到两个正在争执的人之间，掌心朝外
scene: 会议室里两人争论不休，主持人抬起手示意暂停，把一份数据表放到两人之间。She interposed a brief summary before the argument could restart.
sceneCN: 这里 interpose 是「使插入、置于中间」（第 1 个义项：把某物放到两者之间）；句意：在争论再度开始之前，她插入了一段简短的总结。

pos.zh: 使插入；使置于两者之间；提出（异议等）
插话；干预；调停

collocations.zh: 置于甲乙之间；在甲乙之间调停

derivatives.zh: 由 interpose 加名词后缀 -ition 构成，义为「插入；介入；干预」
由 interpose 加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「插入者；居中调停者」

senses.title: To put something between
senses.definition: to place something between two other things, especially to separate them
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放在另外两个事物之间，尤指将它们隔开
senses.example: He interposed a screen between the lamp and the bed.
senses.exampleCN: 他在灯与床之间加了一块挡板。
senses.why: Latin inter- means between and ponere means to put, so the verb literally means to put in between.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 inter- 意为「在……之间」，ponere 意为「放置」，所以这个词的字面意思就是「放到两者中间」，这是所有义项的起点。

senses.title: To put in a word while others speak
senses.definition: to say something in the middle of another person speech or during a pause
senses.definitionCN: 在别人讲话中间或停顿处插入一句自己的话
senses.example: She interposed a question before he could finish.
senses.exampleCN: 他还没说完，她就插进一个问题。
senses.why: Words are things you can place, so putting a remark into a stream of speech reuses the literal between picture.
senses.whyCN: 话也可以像物件一样被「放」，把一句话放进别人说话的流里，就直接沿用「置于中间」的画面，于是长出了「插话」义。

senses.title: To put forward an objection
senses.definition: to raise an objection, claim, or appeal formally before a court or authority
senses.definitionCN: 在法庭或权威机构面前正式提出异议、主张或上诉
senses.example: The company interposed an objection to the new rule.
senses.exampleCN: 公司对这条新规则提出了异议。
senses.why: In legal English a claim is something laid before the court, so interpose keeps its putting sense in a formal register.
senses.whyCN: 在英文法律文书中，诉求要「摆到法庭面前」，因此 interpose 保留「放置」本义，只是对象变成正式的法律主张，于是有了「提出异议」的用法。

senses.title: To intervene or mediate
senses.definition: to place oneself between two sides in order to stop or settle a conflict
senses.definitionCN: 把自己放到冲突双方之间，以阻止或解决冲突
senses.example: A neutral envoy interposed to halt the fighting.
senses.exampleCN: 一位中立的特使出面斡旋，使交战得以停止。
senses.why: If placing something between two parties becomes a person standing between them, the meaning turns active and the verb comes to mean mediation.
senses.whyCN: 当被放进两者之间的东西变成一个人时，动作就带有主动性，含义自然转向「站在中间调停」，于是产生「干预、斡旋」义。

senses.title: To come between in time or sequence
senses.definition: to come between two events in time or between two parts of a whole
senses.definitionCN: 在时间上夹在两个事件之间，或夹在一个整体的两部分之间
senses.example: A long silence interposed before the answer came.
senses.exampleCN: 在回答到来之前，夹了一段长久的沉默。
senses.why: The between image does not need solid things, so even stretches of time and steps in a sequence can interpose.
senses.whyCN: 「在两者之间」的画面不必限于实体物件，时间段和过程的环节同样可以夹在中间，所以这个词也能用于时间与顺序。

intro.en: Interpose comes from Latin interponere, to put between, formed from inter (between) and ponere (to place). It passes into English through French.
intro.cn: interpose 来自拉丁语 interponere（放在中间），由 inter（之间）与 ponere（放置）构成，一般认为经由法语进入英语。

items.en: Inter means between, and ponere means to put or place.
items.cn: 拉丁语 inter 意为之间，ponere 意为放置。

items.en: Interponere, to put between, already covers objects, arguments, and persons.
items.cn: interponere 表示放在中间，当时已可指物件、论点乃至人。

items.en: French interposer takes the verb in and drops the n.
items.cn: 法语 interposer 吸收了这个动词，并去掉了中间的 n。

items.en: English interpose appears in the fifteenth century and grows common in formal prose by the sixteenth.
items.cn: 英语 interpose 一般认为是十五世纪出现的，到十六世纪在正式书面语中已相当常见。

items.en: The verb is used for claims and objections laid before a court.
items.cn: 在法律英语中，这个词用于向法庭提出的主张与异议。

items.en: Modern English keeps the formal and literary colour of the word.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了这个词偏正式、偏书面的色彩。

note.en: Interpose looks like the Latin placing family and shares its field with words about putting something between or butting in.
note.cn: interpose 外形上属于拉丁语「放置」词族，意思上与「插入、介入」一类表达同处一个语义场。

entries.definition: to put parts together
entries.definitionCN: 组成；创作（同词根 ponere，前缀 com- 表示共同）

entries.definition: to put down or lay something down
entries.definitionCN: 放置；存款（同词根 ponere，前缀 de- 表示向下）

entries.definition: to arrange or get rid of
entries.definitionCN: 安排；处置（同词根 ponere，前缀 dis- 表示分开）

entries.definition: to say something suddenly during a conversation
entries.definitionCN: 突然插话（偏打断别人，语气随意，词根是「投掷」）

entries.definition: to put something inside something else
entries.definitionCN: 插入；放进（偏放进某个内部，不一定夹在两者之间）

entries.definition: to act as a go-between to settle a dispute
entries.definitionCN: 调解；居中斡旋（与「干预、调停」义项相对）

normalIntro.en: Interpose is Latin inter plus ponere: to place a thing between two others.
normalIntro.cn: interpose 就是拉丁语 inter 加 ponere：把一样东西搁到另两样东西中间。

normal.en: The same ponere root gives compose, deposit, dispose, and expose.
normal.cn: 同样的 ponere 词根还构成 compose、deposit、dispose、expose。

normal.en: Interpose takes an object: interpose a screen, interpose an objection.
normal.cn: interpose 后面要跟宾语：架一块挡板、提一项异议。

normal.en: The pattern interpose between A and B is the clearest guide to its meaning.
normal.cn: 搭配「置于甲与乙之间」最能看出它的本义。

normal.en: The noun is interposition, and it survives in law and diplomacy.
normal.cn: 名词形式是 interposition，至今用于法律与外交语境。

normal.en: Interpose is formal and somewhat literary; in speech people often say put in or butt in.
normal.cn: interpose 偏正式且带书面感；日常口语里常说「插进去」「插嘴」。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised flat between two angry people.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手掌平平地伸在两个正在生气的人之间。

abstract.en: Think of a thin glass sheet slid between two sheets of paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一张薄玻璃片被塞进两页纸之间。

abstract.en: Hear one calm sentence dropped into a noisy argument.
abstract.cn: 想象一句平静的话被丢进吵闹的争论里。

examples.en: The judge interposed a question during the testimony.
examples.cn: 法官在证词进行中插问了一句。

examples.en: UN officials interposed between the two sides.
examples.cn: 联合国官员在双方之间居中调停。

examples.en: She interposed her hand to block the bright light.
examples.cn: 她把手挡在眼前遮住强光。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特泡丝」——因（为）特（意）泡（在）丝（线）中间 → 把丝线插到两股之间，就是「插入、居于中间」；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 inter（在……之间）+ ponere（放置）→ interponere（放在中间）→ 法语 interposer → 英语 interpose，核心义「把东西放到两者之间」。

sensesIntro.en: Interpose begins with placing an object between two others, extends to words put into speech and claims laid before a court, and ends with a person standing between two sides.
sensesIntro.cn: interpose 从在物体间放东西开始，延伸到插话与提出法律主张，最后指一个人站在两方之间调停。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand held flat between two arguing people.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手平伸在两个争执者之间。

branches.en: Placing separate things between is the literal sense.
branches.cn: 在两物之间搁东西是字面义项。

branches.en: Remarks and spans of time can be inserted like objects.
branches.cn: 话语与时间段落都能像物件一样被插进去。

branches.en: A legal objection is a claim laid before a court.
branches.cn: 法律异议是摆到法庭面前的主张。

branches.en: Coming between two sides or two moments makes the verb take on time and mediation.
branches.cn: 夹在双方或两个时刻之间，让这个词获得时间与调停的含义。

branches.en: Whether a screen or a mediator is placed, something goes in between.
branches.cn: 不管是挡板还是调停者，都是有东西被放到中间。

intro.en: Interpose is built from the Latin prefix inter- and the root pon-, from ponere, and it belongs to a large family of placing verbs.
intro.cn: interpose 由拉丁语前缀 inter- 与词根 pon-（来自 ponere）构成，并与一大批「放置」类动词同属一族。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter means between and ponere means to put or place, so interponere already meant to put between.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 意为之间，ponere 意为放置，因此 interponere 自古就是「放在中间」。

items.example: Inter- shows the position of the action.
items.exampleCN: inter- 标出动作所处的位置。

items.example: Ponere is the placing root.
items.exampleCN: ponere 是「放置」词根。

items.meaning: the shape of the placed verb
items.example: The ending -se matches compose and suppose.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -se 与 compose、suppose 一致。

items.example: Interpose keeps the Latin sense whole.
items.exampleCN: interpose 完整保留了拉丁语含义。

items.example: Interposition is the noun of the act.
items.exampleCN: interposition 是表示这一动作的名词。

items.example: Propose puts forward, interpose puts between.
items.exampleCN: propose 是往前放，interpose 是放中间。

items.example: Expose puts a thing out in the open.
items.exampleCN: expose 是把东西放到外面。

items.example: Postpone puts a date later.
items.exampleCN: postpone 是把日期放到后面。

items.example: Component keeps the same placing root.
items.exampleCN: component 保留了同一个「放置」词根。

definition_zh: 口译者；译员；解释者；（计算机）解释程序
definition_en: a person who translates speech from one language into another as it is spoken; a program that translates and runs code line by line
core_image: 一个人戴着耳机站在两位说话者之间，把一边的话立即翻成另一边听得懂的语言
scene: 医院走廊里，护士与年长的病人语言不通，站在中间的翻译一边听一边轻声转述。The interpreter explained each question slowly and clearly.
sceneCN: 这里 interpreter 是「口译者、译员」（第 1 个义项：把一方的话当场译成另一方的语言）；句意：翻译把每个问题都讲得又慢又清楚。

pos.zh: 口译者；译员；解释者；解释程序

derivatives.zh: 由 interpret 加施事后缀 -er 构成名词；动词本身义为「解释；口译；理解」
由 interpret 加名词后缀 -ation 构成，义为「解释；诠释；口译结果」
由 interpret 加 -ive 构成，义为「解释性的；诠释性的」
由 interpreter 加 -less 构成，义为「没有译员的」

senses.title: A person who translates speech
senses.definition: someone whose job is to translate what people say from one language into another, usually while they speak
senses.definitionCN: 以把人们说的话从一种语言当场译成另一种语言为职业的人
senses.example: The interpreter repeated the doctor words in Nepali.
senses.exampleCN: 译员用尼泊尔语把医生的话重复了一遍。
senses.why: The agent ending -er turns interpret, a verb for carrying meaning across, into the person who does the carrying aloud.
senses.whyCN: 施事后缀 -er 把「把意思运过去」的动词 interpret 变成做这件事的人，而口译是把它放在口头当场完成，于是有了「译员」这一义项。

senses.title: Someone who explains a text or symbol
senses.definition: someone who explains or gives the meaning of a text, poem, dream, or sign
senses.definitionCN: 解释文本、诗、梦或符号含义的人
senses.example: Ancient kings kept an interpreter of dreams at court.
senses.exampleCN: 古代宫廷里设有解梦的人。
senses.why: Long before modern professional translation, interpreters were people who read meanings out of dreams, omens, and sacred texts.
senses.whyCN: 早在现代职业翻译出现之前，解释者就是能从梦、征兆和圣典里读出意义的人，因此这一义项比「译员」更古老也更宽泛。

senses.title: A program that runs code
senses.definition: a computer program that translates a program line by line and executes it directly
senses.definitionCN: 逐行翻译程序代码并直接执行翻译结果的计算机程序
senses.example: The Python interpreter reads the script one line at a time.
senses.exampleCN: Python 解释器一次读一行脚本。
senses.why: The computing sense borrows the human go-between image: the program stands between a written script and the machine that runs it.
senses.whyCN: 计算机义项借用人与人之间传话者的形象：程序站在脚本文本与真正执行命令的机器之间，逐行把代码「翻译」成机器动作。

senses.title: Someone who gives expression to a group
senses.definition: a person or thing that expresses the ideas, feelings, or will of a group
senses.definitionCN: 表达某个群体的想法、情感或意愿的人或事物
senses.example: The young poet became an interpreter of her generation.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻诗人成了她那一代人的代言人。
senses.why: If meaning can be carried from one language to another, it can also be carried from a silent group outward to the world.
senses.whyCN: 既然意义能从一种语言运到另一种语言，它也能从一个沉默的群体向外运到世人面前，于是产生了「代言、表达」的义项。

senses.title: A translation device
senses.definition: a small device or app that translates speech or text for travel and daily use
senses.definitionCN: 在旅行与日常生活中翻译语音或文字的小型设备或应用程序
senses.example: She carried a pocket interpreter on the trip.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行时她随身带了一台袖珍翻译机。
senses.why: As machines took over the go-between role, the word extended from the person to the tool that now does the same job.
senses.whyCN: 当机器接过传话者的角色，这个词就从人延伸到承担同样工作的工具，因此小型翻译机和翻译应用也用它来命名。

intro.en: Interpreter comes from Latin interpres, usually explained as coming from inter (between) plus a disputed second element, often linked to pretium (price) in the sense of a negotiator.
intro.cn: interpreter 来自拉丁语 interpres（中间人、译者）；其第二成分来源不确定，一般认为与 inter（之间）有关，常被联系到 pretium（价格），取「议价人、中间人」之意，但并未确立。

items.en: Interpres names a go-between who negotiates, explains, or translates.
items.cn: interpres 指议价、说明或翻译的中间人。

items.en: The second part of interpres is debated; the link to pretium, meaning price, is only one proposal.
items.cn: interpres 的第二部分有争议，与 pretium（价格）相关的解释只是其中一种假说。

items.en: Interprete and its verb interpreter pass the word into French.
items.cn: 古法语 interprete 及其动词形式把该词带入法语。

items.en: Purvey and Trevisa use interpreter for a person who explains meaning.
items.cn: 中古英语作家 Purvey 与 Trevisa 用它指解释意义的人。

items.en: The word settles on the spoken translator, and the dream-reading sense fades into literature.
items.cn: 到十六至十八世纪，词义稳定在口头译者上，解梦之类的古老用法退入文学语境。

items.en: The computer age gives it a new sense as a program or device that translates code.
items.cn: 计算机时代又赋予它新义，指翻译代码的程序或设备。

note.en: Interpreter belongs to the interpret family and sits beside translator among people who move meaning between languages.
note.cn: interpreter 属于 interpret 词族，意思上与「译」字辈的其他说法聚在一起，最典型的是 translator。

entries.definition: the act or result of explaining or translating
entries.definitionCN: 解释；诠释；口译（同词根 interpret 的名词）

entries.definition: to understand or explain something wrongly
entries.definitionCN: 误解；误译（同词根加 mis- 表示错误）

entries.definition: to stop someone while they are speaking
entries.definitionCN: 打断；中断（只是拼写与发音相近，词源是拉丁语 rumpere「折断」，词源不同）

entries.definition: a person who turns written text from one language into another
entries.definitionCN: 笔译者（偏书面文本转换，与口译相对）

entries.definition: a person who helps two sides reach agreement
entries.definitionCN: 调解人（偏化解分歧，不涉及语言转换）

entries.definition: a person who speaks officially for a group
entries.definitionCN: 发言人（偏代表群体对外讲话，与「代言」义项相对）

normalIntro.en: Interpreter is the agent noun of interpret: the person who stands between languages and carries meaning across.
normalIntro.cn: interpreter 是 interpret 的施事名词：站在语言之间、把意思运过去的那个人。

normal.en: The base verb is interpret, so interpreter carries the same inter- link.
normal.cn: 基础动词是 interpret，因此 interpreter 同样带着「在两者之间」的 inter-。

normal.en: Remember translator for writing and interpreter for speech.
normal.cn: 记住：translator 用于笔译，interpreter 用于口译。

normal.en: An interpreter often leaves out the subject pronoun I in English, because the first person speaks through it.
normal.cn: 口译者常省略英语中的第一人称代词，因为第一人称是透过他在说话。

normal.en: In computing the interpreter translates and runs each line, unlike a compiler.
normal.cn: 在计算机领域，解释器逐行翻译并执行，与编译器不同。

normal.en: The family also gives interpretation, interpretive, and misinterpret.
normal.cn: 同一词族还给出 interpretation、interpretive 与 misinterpret。

abstract.en: See a person in a booth pressing headphones to their ears.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人坐在同传间里，把耳机紧紧贴在耳朵上。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge made of a single voice joining two banks.
abstract.cn: 想象一座由一道声音搭成的桥，把两岸连起来。

abstract.en: Think of a thin program reading a script line by line, like a careful reader aloud.
abstract.cn: 想象一个轻巧的程序像朗读的人一样，一行一行地读脚本。

examples.en: We met the minister through an interpreter.
examples.cn: 我们通过译员见到了部长。

examples.en: Good interpreters need fast memory and deep cultural knowledge.
examples.cn: 优秀的口译员需要敏捷的记忆与深厚的文化知识。

examples.en: The browsing experience depends on the JavaScript interpreter.
examples.cn: 浏览体验取决于 JavaScript 解释器。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特普瑞特」——因（为）特（别）普瑞特（会）在中间转述 → interpreter 中间传话的译员；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 interpres（中间人、译者），一般认为由 inter（在……之间）加一个来源存疑的成分构成（常联系到 pretium「价格」，未确立）→ 古法语 → 中古英语 interpreter，核心义「站在两方之间传话的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Interpreter starts with the person who translates speech on the spot, widens to any explainer of meaning, then narrows again to programs and devices that carry information across.
sensesIntro.cn: interpreter 先指当场把话译出来的人，再放宽到任何解释意义的人，最后又收窄到把信息运过去的程序与设备。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person with headphones standing between two speakers.
core.cn: 核心意象：戴耳机的人站在两位说话者之间。

branches.en: The spoken translator is the modern core sense.
branches.cn: 口译译员是现代核心义项。

branches.en: Explaining dreams and texts is the older, wider sense.
branches.cn: 解梦与释文是更古老、更宽泛的义项。

branches.en: Programs and devices take over the go-between job.
branches.cn: 程序与设备接过了中间人的工作。

branches.en: Both a translator and an explainer stand between meaning and a listener.
branches.cn: 译员与解释者都站在意义与听者之间。

branches.en: A group needs a voice just as a speaker needs a second language.
branches.cn: 群体需要一个声音，正如说话者需要另一种语言。

intro.en: Interpreter is the agent noun of interpret, built with the ending -er, and it appears in a wide family of interpret words.
intro.cn: interpreter 是 interpret 的施事名词，由后缀 -er 构成，并与一大批 interpret 词族成员一起使用。

latinIntro.en: Latin interpres, of unclear second element, gives interpret and interpreter through French, and inter means between.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 interpres（第二成分来源不确定）经由法语给出 interpret 与 interpreter，而其中的 inter 意为「在……之间」。

items.example: Inter- shows the space the work happens in.
items.exampleCN: inter- 标出这项工作发生的空间。

items.meaning: a person who does the action
items.example: The ending -er makes interpret into a person.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 把 interpret 变成人的称呼。

items.example: Interpret is the base verb.
items.exampleCN: interpret 是基础动词。

items.example: Interpreter is the agent noun.
items.exampleCN: interpreter 是施事名词。

items.meaning: the act or result of interpreting
items.example: Interpretation names the act.
items.exampleCN: interpretation 指这一行为本身。

items.example: Interpretive describes explanatory work.
items.exampleCN: interpretive 描述解释性的工作。

items.example: Mis- adds a wrong turn to interpret.
items.exampleCN: mis- 给 interpret 加上「弄错」的意思。

items.example: Misinterpret is the common negative verb.
items.exampleCN: misinterpret 是常见的否定动词。

items.meaning: a person who turns written text
items.example: Translator is the written-text partner.
items.exampleCN: translator 是与书面文本搭配的伙伴词。

definition_zh: 相互关系；相互联系；互相关联
definition_en: a mutual connection between two or more things, in which each affects or depends on the other
core_image: 两枚齿轮咬合在一起，转动其中一个，另一个也跟着转
scene: 研究气候与农业时，学者特别强调降雨和收成之间的相互关系。The scholars stressed the close interrelation between rainfall and harvest.
sceneCN: 这里 interrelation 是「相互关系」（第 1 个义项：两个或多个事物彼此牵连的状态）；句意：研究气候与农业时，学者特别强调降雨和收成之间的相互关系。

pos.zh: 相互关系；相互联系

derivatives.zh: 由 inter 与 relate 合成，义为「相互关联」
加过去分词词尾 -ed，义为「相互关联的」
再加后缀 -ship，义为「相互关系」
interrelated 加后缀 -ness，义为「相互关联性」

senses.title: A mutual connection between things
senses.definition: the way in which two or more things are connected to and affect each other
senses.definitionCN: 两个或多个事物彼此相连并互相影响的方式
senses.example: The report explores the interrelation of climate and farming.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告探讨气候与农业之间的相互关系。
senses.why: Latin inter- means between, and relate carries the image of a tie, so interrelation is a tie that runs in both directions.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语前缀 inter- 表示「在……之间」，relate 带着「系在一起」的意象，所以相互关系是双向的连线。

senses.title: Mutual dependence among parts of a whole
senses.titleCN: （系统内部的）互相关联；依存关系
senses.definition: the condition in which parts of a system depend on one another for their working or survival
senses.definitionCN: 系统中各部分为了运转或存续而彼此依赖的状态
senses.example: Biologists study the interrelation of plants and insects in a forest.
senses.exampleCN: 生物学家研究森林里植物与昆虫之间的依存关系。
senses.why: If two things affect each other, each must depend on the other to some degree, so the tie becomes a supporting structure.
senses.whyCN: 两个事物若彼此影响，就必然在某种程度上互相依赖，于是这条连线变成了一张互相支撑的网。

senses.title: The state of being linked in a network
senses.titleCN: 网络式的联结；牵一发而动全身的状态
senses.definition: a web of many connections in which changes to one point spread to the others
senses.definitionCN: 许多连线交织成网，一处变化会波及其他处的状态
senses.example: Economists note the interrelation between trade, wages, and migration.
senses.exampleCN: 经济学家注意到贸易、工资与移民之间的网式关联。
senses.why: Put many pairs of tied things together and the pairs form a network in which a pull on one thread moves all of them.
senses.whyCN: 把许多成对的连线拼在一起，就成了网络，拉动其中一根线，整张网都会动。

senses.title: A study of how things are connected
senses.titleCN: （对相互关系的）研究；关联分析
senses.definition: the examination or description of the connections between phenomena
senses.definitionCN: 对现象间种种联系所作的考察或描述
senses.example: Her thesis is an interrelation of language and memory.
senses.exampleCN: 她的论文是对语言与记忆关联的分析。
senses.why: Once the tie is named as a thing, people begin to examine it, so the noun comes to mean the study of that tie.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这条连线被命名成一个实体，人们就会去考察它，于是名词又有了「关联研究」的意思。

senses.title: Physical linkage of parts
senses.definition: a mechanical or practical connection that lets one part drive another
senses.definitionCN: 使一个部件带动另一个部件的机械或实际连结
senses.example: Engineers built an interrelation between the two control levers.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师让两个操纵杆之间形成了联动。
senses.why: The gear image is literal here: a link that forces two parts to move together is a mechanical interrelation.
senses.whyCN: 这里齿轮意象是字面的：迫使两个部件一起运动的连接，就是机械上的联动。

senses.title: Mutual reference between texts or ideas
senses.titleCN: （文本、观念间的）互相指涉；相呼应
senses.definition: a link in which one text, idea, or field points to another and is understood through it
senses.definitionCN: 一个文本、观念或领域指向另一个、并借由它被理解的联系
senses.example: Critics point to the interrelation of the poem and its times.
senses.exampleCN: 评论者指出这首诗与其时代之间的互相指涉。
senses.why: When two writings echo each other, each is read through the other, the same two-way tie moved into the world of meaning.
senses.whyCN: 两篇文字相互呼应时，读其一要借助其二，把双向连线搬进了意义的世界。

senses.title: A family or group tie
senses.definition: the relationship that connects relatives, neighbours, or members of a group
senses.definitionCN: 把亲属、邻里或群体的成员连在一起的关系
senses.example: The novel traces the interrelations within one family.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说追溯了一个家庭内部的相互关系。
senses.why: Between people the same mutual tie shows up as kinship and obligation, so interrelation also names social bonds.
senses.whyCN: 在人与人之间，这条双向连线表现为亲情与义务，所以相互关系也能指社会纽带。

senses.title: A working relationship between organizations
senses.titleCN: （机构间的）协作关系；相互配合
senses.definition: the way institutions or offices cooperate and depend on each other in practice
senses.definitionCN: 各机构或部门在实际运作中互相配合、彼此依赖的方式
senses.example: The two offices set up a clear interrelation of duties.
senses.exampleCN: 两个机构就职责设立了明确的相互配合关系。
senses.why: Gears that must turn together are a perfect picture of offices that must work together, so the word extends to institutions.
senses.whyCN: 必须一起转动的齿轮，正是必须协同办公的部门的写照，所以这个词延伸到机构层面。

intro.en: Interrelation is a modern Latin-derived compound: the prefix inter-, between, plus relation, a tie, with something deliberately joined in the middle.
intro.cn: interrelation 是近代仿拉丁语构成的复合词：前缀 inter-（在……之间）加上 relation（联系），中间还加了一个连接成分。

items.en: Inter means between or among, and relatio means a bringing back or a reference.
items.cn: inter 意为在……之间，relatio 意为带回、转述或关联。

items.en: Relation enters English through Old French as a recounting and later as a tie between things.
items.cn: relation 经古法语进入英语，先指叙述，后指事物之间的联系。

items.en: Writers bound together such pairs as inter-allied and inter-continental with the same prefix.
items.cn: 写作者用同一前缀造出「盟国之间的」「洲际的」这类词。

items.en: Interrelation appears with interrelate, which joins inter- to the already formed relate rather than to bare Latin roots.
items.cn: interrelation 与 interrelate 一同出现，inter- 是加在已有的 relate 上，而非直接接拉丁词根。

items.en: The word spreads in science and social study, where everything is said to be interrelated.
items.cn: 这个词在科学与社会科学中流行起来，凡事物都被说成相互关联的。

note.en: Interrelation is the noun of a two-way tie; it sits beside its family words and near the plain words relationship and connection.
note.cn: interrelation 是表示「双向连线」的名词，既靠近它的词族成员，也靠近 relationship、connection 这类普通词。

entries.definition: to be connected to each other
entries.definitionCN: 相互关联

entries.definition: connected so that each affects the other
entries.definitionCN: 相互关联的

entries.definition: a connection between things
entries.definitionCN: 关系；联系

entries.definition: the way two people or things are connected
entries.definitionCN: 关系；关联

entries.definition: a link between things or ideas
entries.definitionCN: 联系；关联

entries.definition: a mutual relation shown by shared change
entries.definitionCN: 相关；关联（统计学用语）

normalIntro.en: Interrelation is the noun of things tied both ways: inter- says between, relate says link, so the tie runs from each to the other.
normalIntro.cn: interrelation 是表示双向牵引的名词：inter- 说「在……之间」，relate 说「连起来」，于是连线从一头通到另一头。

normal.en: The prefix inter- means between, as in international and intercity.
normal.cn: 前缀 inter- 表示在……之间，如「国际的」「城际的」。

normal.en: Add the suffix -tion to a verb and you get the noun, so interrelate becomes interrelation.
normal.cn: 动词加后缀 -tion 构成名词，于是 interrelate 变成 interrelation。

normal.en: The plural interrelations is common in reports about many linked factors.
normal.cn: 复数形式 interrelations 常见于讨论诸多相互关联因素的报告中。

normal.en: Compare relation: relation can be one-way, interrelation is always mutual.
normal.cn: 对比 relation：relation 可以是单向的，interrelation 则始终是相互的。

normal.en: Its relatives interrelate and interrelated keep the same tie in verb and adjective form.
normal.cn: 同族词 interrelate 与 interrelated 以动词和形容词形式保留同一层牵连。

abstract.en: Picture two cogs whose teeth lock together so that neither can turn alone.
abstract.cn: 想象两个齿轮的齿咬合在一起，谁也没法独自转动。

abstract.en: Imagine two people holding one rope, so a pull on either side moves both.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人共握一根绳子，任何一方拉动，双方都会动。

abstract.en: Think of a spider web: every strand is tied to the others and shakes with them.
abstract.cn: 想一想蛛网：每一根丝都与其他丝相连，随之一起颤动。

examples.en: The paper explains the interrelation between diet and health.
examples.cn: 这篇论文阐释了饮食与健康之间的相互关系。

examples.en: Teachers often overlook the interrelation of language and culture.
examples.cn: 教师常常忽视语言与文化之间的相互联系。

examples.en: The two departments have a clear interrelation in daily work.
examples.cn: 这两个部门在日常工作中有着明确的相互配合关系。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特-瑞雷-申」——因特网把人和事「连」在一起，里面处处是相互关系；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语前缀 inter-（在……之间）+ 动词 relate（关联，源于拉丁语 referre 的过去分词 relatus）→ interrelate → interrelation，核心义「双向连线」。

sensesIntro.en: Interrelation grows from the picture of two tied things to the dependence of parts in a system, the web of a whole network, the study of such links, and then to physical, textual, family, and institutional ties.
sensesIntro.cn: interrelation 从「两个事物被系在一起」的画面出发，先指相互联系，再指系统内的依存、整张网的联结、对联系的研究，最后延伸到机械联动、文本指涉、家庭牵连与机构协作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two cogs whose teeth lock, so that one cannot turn without the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个齿轮咬合，一个转动另一个必然跟转。

branches.en: A mutual connection is the basic sense of the word.
branches.cn: 相互联系是这个词的基本义。

branches.en: Mutual dependence makes the tie part of a working structure.
branches.cn: 互相依赖让这条连线成为运转结构的一部分。

branches.en: Many ties together form a network in which a pull travels.
branches.cn: 许多连线合起来构成一张牵动全局的网络。

branches.en: Both the study of links and textual reference treat the tie itself as an object to be read.
branches.cn: 联系研究与文本指涉都把这条连线本身当作可解读的对象。

branches.en: Machines, families, and offices all show the same gear-like mutual tie.
branches.cn: 机器、家庭与机构都呈现出同样的齿轮式牵连。

intro.en: Interrelation is built from the Latin prefix inter- and the tie word relate, with -tion turning the verb into a noun.
intro.cn: interrelation 由拉丁语前缀 inter- 与表示「牵连」的 relate 构成，后缀 -tion 把动词变成名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter means between, and relatio means a bringing back or a reference.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 意为在……之间，relatio 意为带回、转述或关联。

items.example: The prefix inter- appears in international and intercity.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 inter- 见于「国际的」与「城际的」。

items.example: The suffix -ation turns relate into relation.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ation 把 relate 变成 relation。

items.exampleCN: interrelate 让牵连成为动作。

items.example: Interrelated describes things that affect each other.

definition_zh: 相互关系；相互联系；相互依存关系
definition_en: the state or quality of being connected to and affecting one another
core_image: 一张网里许多节点被细线连起来，每个节点都被别处牵着
scene: 社会学家研究家庭结构与就业之间的相互关系，发现二者常常同步变化。The sociologists studied the interrelationship between family structure and employment.
sceneCN: 这里 interrelationship 是「相互关系」（第 1 个义项：两个或多个事物彼此牵连的状态）；句意：社会学家研究家庭结构与就业之间的相互关系，发现二者常常同步变化。

pos.zh: 相互关系；相互联系

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀 -ship，义为「相互联系」
由 inter 与 relate 合成，义为「相互关联」
加过去分词词尾 -ed，义为「相互关联的」
加后缀 -ness，义为「相互关联性」

senses.title: The state of being connected to one another
senses.titleCN: 相互关系；相互联系状态
senses.definition: the state in which two or more things are joined and affect each other
senses.definitionCN: 两个或多个事物相连并彼此影响的状态
senses.example: We need to understand the interrelationship of poverty and crime.
senses.exampleCN: 我们需要理解贫困与犯罪之间的相互关系。
senses.why: The suffix -ship names a condition, so adding it to the tie word turns a mutual link into a state that things are in.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ship 表状态，把它加到表示牵连的词上，就把双向连线变成长久所处的状态。

senses.title: A mutual dependence
senses.definition: a condition in which each side needs the other in order to work or survive
senses.definitionCN: 各方为了运转或存续而彼此需要的状态
senses.example: The interrelationship of the two species keeps the reef alive.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个物种的相互依存关系维系着整片珊瑚礁。
senses.why: In a living web, tied things feed and shelter each other, so mutual tie deepens into mutual need.
senses.whyCN: 在生命的网中，相连的事物互相供食、互相庇护，于是相互牵连加深为相互需要。

senses.title: A two-way way of influencing
senses.titleCN: 相互影响；双向作用关系
senses.definition: the way two things change each other over time, with influence moving both ways
senses.definitionCN: 两个事物随时间互相改变、影响双向流动的方式
senses.example: Teachers talk about the interrelationship of motivation and skill.
senses.exampleCN: 老师们谈到动机与技能之间的相互影响。
senses.why: When the tie runs both ways, a change on one side returns to it as a change from the other side, forming influence.
senses.whyCN: 连线若双向通行，一方的变化会经对侧回到自身，这就形成了相互影响。

senses.title: Connection among several linked things
senses.titleCN: （多者间的）相互连带关系；连锁关系
senses.definition: a group of links joining many things so that a change in one reaches all
senses.definitionCN: 把多个事物串成一片、一处变动波及全部的诸多联系
senses.example: The plan must account for the interrelationships among the three systems.
senses.exampleCN: 该方案必须考虑到三大系统之间的相互连带关系。
senses.why: Interrelation already allows many pairs; the state suffix lets the whole knot of pairs be named as one thing.
senses.whyCN: interrelation 本就容得下许多对连线，状态后缀把这些连线打成的结整体命名。

senses.title: A formal working tie between groups
senses.titleCN: （机构间的）相互关系；协作关系
senses.definition: a formal or practical relationship between organizations that must cooperate
senses.definitionCN: 必须互相配合的机构之间正式或实际的关系
senses.example: The two ministries defined their interrelationship in a joint document.
senses.exampleCN: 两个部委在一份联合文件中界定了彼此的关系。
senses.why: Institutions held together by shared duties take on the same state of mutual tying that cogs show.
senses.whyCN: 由共同职责连在一起的机构，呈现出与齿轮相同的相互牵连状态。

senses.title: Correspondence between paired items
senses.titleCN: （两项间的）对应关系；相称关系
senses.definition: a link in which one item has a matching or answering item
senses.definitionCN: 一物在另一侧有相应之物、彼此呼应的联系
senses.example: The chart shows the interrelationship between effort and reward.
senses.exampleCN: 图表显示了努力与回报之间的对应关系。
senses.why: Each of two tied things can be read as the answer to the other, so the tie also appears as a pairing.
senses.whyCN: 两个相连之物，彼此都可看作对方的应答，于是连线又呈现为配对。

senses.title: Mutual connection in human life
senses.titleCN: （人际关系层面的）相互关系；牵连
senses.definition: the tie that joins people in a family, community, or team
senses.definitionCN: 在家庭、社区或团队中把人们连在一起的关系
senses.example: They wrote about the interrelationship of parents and children.
senses.exampleCN: 他们论述了父母与子女之间的相互关系。
senses.why: Between people the state of being tied becomes duty and care, so the word reaches the social sphere.
senses.whyCN: 在人与人之间，相互牵连的状态变成了责任与关爱，于是这个词走进社会领域。

senses.title: A link that keeps separate things in balance
senses.definition: a link in which the parts hold one another steady by pulling against each other
senses.definitionCN: 各部分彼此牵制而使整体保持稳定的关系
senses.example: The interrelationship of supply and demand steadies the market.
senses.exampleCN: 供需之间的相互关系使市场保持稳定。
senses.why: Two cogs can also jam each other, and that holding still is the same tie working as balance.
senses.whyCN: 两个齿轮也能互相卡住，这种彼此停住同样是这条连线在起平衡作用。

intro.en: Interrelationship is late and plainly built: the prefix inter- plus relationship, as the -ship form of interrelation.
intro.cn: interrelationship 出现较晚，构词一目了然：前缀 inter- 加上 relationship，相当于 interrelation 的 -ship 形式。

items.en: Inter means between, and relatio means a bringing back or a reference.
items.cn: inter 意为在……之间，relatio 意为带回、转述或关联。

items.en: The suffix -scipe or -scip means condition or office, giving modern -ship.
items.cn: 古英语后缀 -scipe 意为状态、身份，演变为现在的 -ship。

items.en: Relationship is recorded as the state of being related before it develops its modern social sense.
items.cn: relationship 先有「相关联的状态」之意，后来才发展出社会意义上的关系。

items.en: Interrelation and interrelate give the mutual form, and interrelationship follows with the state suffix.
items.cn: interrelation 与 interrelate 给出相互形式，interrelationship 随后加上状态后缀出现。

items.en: The word is now common in academic writing about linked factors and systems.
items.cn: 如今这个词常见于讨论相互关联因素与系统的学术写作。

note.en: Interrelationship keeps the two-way tie and wraps it in a state suffix; its family words share the tie and near neighbours share the idea of connection.
note.cn: interrelationship 保留双向连线，又给它套上表状态的词尾；词族成员共享这层牵连，近邻词则共享「联系」的概念。
