normalIntro.en: Interrelationship is the state form of a mutual tie: inter- means between, relate means link, and -ship means condition.
normalIntro.cn: interrelationship 是双向连线的状态形式：inter- 表示「之间」，relate 表示「连起来」，-ship 表示「状态」。

normal.en: The suffix -ship marks a state, as in friendship and membership, and works the same way here.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ship 表状态，见于「友谊」「会员资格」，这里同理。

normal.en: It is longer than interrelation but means nearly the same; the -ship just stresses the lasting state.
normal.cn: 它比 interrelation 更长，意思几乎相同，-ship 只是更强调持续的状态。

normal.en: The plural interrelationships is used when many linked pairs are counted together.
normal.cn: 把许多对联系合起来计数时，用复数 interrelationships。

normal.en: Drop inter- and you get relationship, the plain word for any tie.
normal.cn: 去掉 inter-，剩下 relationship，就是任何联系的一般说法。

normal.en: Watch the spelling: inter plus re plus lation plus ship, with no double letters.
normal.cn: 注意拼写：在 inter 后接 re、lation、ship，各部分间没有字母重复。

abstract.en: Picture a net of nodes with fine threads running both ways between them.
abstract.cn: 想象一张网的节点之间都有双向细线相通。

abstract.en: Imagine two people rowing one boat, each stroke answered by the other.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人同划一条船，每次划桨都由对方回应。

abstract.en: Think of two roots feeding one tree from opposite sides.
abstract.cn: 想一想从两侧同时滋养一棵树的两条根。

examples.en: The lecture explained the interrelationship between sleep and memory.
examples.cn: 这堂课讲解了睡眠与记忆之间的相互关系。

examples.en: Researchers are only beginning to map the interrelationships among these factors.
examples.cn: 研究者才刚刚开始梳理这些因素之间的相互联系。

examples.en: A good essay shows the interrelationship of cause and effect.
examples.cn: 一篇好文章会呈现因果之间的相互关联。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特-瑞雷-申-希普」——「船」是伙伴的船，两人共划才走得动，正好像相互关系；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语前缀 inter-（在……之间）+ relate（关联）+ 古英语后缀 -ship（状态）→ interrelationship，核心义「相互牵连并持续的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Interrelationship first names the state of being tied to another, then mutual dependence and two-way influence, then a chain among many things, a formal tie, a pairing, a human tie, and finally a balancing pull.
sensesIntro.cn: interrelationship 先指「彼此相连的状态」，再指相互依存与双向影响，进而指多者间的连带、机构间的正式关系、对应关系、人际关系，最后指彼此制衡的平衡关系。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a net of nodes joined by threads that run both ways.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张网，节点之间都有来回相通的线。

branches.en: The state of being connected is the core sense of the word.
branches.cn: 彼此相连的状态是这个词的核心义。

branches.en: Dependence and two-way influence are the tie in motion.
branches.cn: 依存与双向影响是这条连线在运动中呈现的样子。

branches.en: Many linked things and paired items are the tie seen as a network or a match.
branches.cn: 多者连带与成对对应，是连线以网络或配对形式出现。

branches.en: Formal ties between groups and ties among people show the same state in society.
branches.cn: 机构之间的正式关系与人际关系，是社会层面的同一状态。

branches.en: A balancing pull is the mutual tie holding still.
branches.cn: 相互制衡是这条连线停住不动时的形态。

intro.en: Interrelationship joins the prefix inter-, the link verb relate, and the state suffix -ship, with -tion making the noun earlier.
intro.cn: interrelationship 由前缀 inter-、表牵连的动词 relate 与表状态的后缀 -ship 拼成，其中 -tion 先把词变成名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter means between, and relatio means a reference or a connection.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter 意为在……之间，relatio 意为关联或转述。

items.example: The prefix inter- appears in intercontinental.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 inter- 见于「洲际的」。

items.example: Relate names the act of linking.
items.exampleCN: relate 表示连接这一动作。

items.example: The suffix -tion forms relation from relate.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tion 把 relate 构成 relation。

items.example: Relation is the core noun of the family.
items.exampleCN: relation 是这一词族的核心名词。

items.example: The suffix -ship turns relationship into a state.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ship 把 relationship 变成一种状态。

items.example: Relationship is the plain form without inter-.
items.exampleCN: relationship 是不带 inter- 的普通形式。

items.example: Interrelationship combines the mutual prefix with the state suffix.
items.exampleCN: interrelationship 把「相互」前缀与状态后缀合在一起。

items.example: Interrelate is the verb behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: interrelate 是这个名词背后的动词。

items.example: Interrelated describes linked things.
items.exampleCN: interrelated 描述彼此相连的事物。

items.example: Interconnected is a close cousin in meaning.
items.exampleCN: interconnected 在意义上是很近的同类词。

definition_zh: 质问的；疑问的；审讯性的；书面质询
definition_en: asking or expressing a question, often in a formal or forceful way, or a written set of questions in legal proceedings
core_image: 一盏灯直照过来，一束尖利的光钉住被问的人
scene: 律师把一叠问题清单交到对方手里，要求逐条书面回答。The lawyer handed over a list of interrogatories that had to be answered in writing.
sceneCN: 这里 interrogatory 是「书面质询」（第 6 个义项：诉讼中一方要求另一方书面答复的问题清单）；句意：律师把一叠问题清单交到对方手里，要求逐条书面回答。

pos.zh: 质问的；疑问的；审讯性的
质询；书面质询（清单）

derivatives.zh: 同源动词，义为「审问；盘问」
加后缀 -tion，义为「审问；盘问」
加后缀 -or，义为「审讯者；提问者」
同源形容词，义为「疑问的；表疑问的」

senses.title: Expressing a question
senses.definition: showing that a question is being asked
senses.definitionCN: 表明正在提出问题的
senses.example: He raised an interrogatory eyebrow at her answer.
senses.exampleCN: 听到她的回答，他挑起眉毛表示疑问。
senses.why: Latin interrogare is to ask, so the adjective first simply describes anything that carries a question.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 interrogare 意为「发问」，所以这个形容词最初只是描述「带着问题的」事物。

senses.title: Questioning in a forceful, probing way
senses.definition: asking in a searching or demanding manner, like someone insisting on answers
senses.definitionCN: 以追究、逼问的方式发问，仿佛非要答复不可
senses.example: The dealer turned an interrogatory stare on me.
senses.exampleCN: 那位商人以质询的目光盯着我。
senses.why: When the question is pressed hard, the plain ask darkens into a challenge, and the light beam becomes a spotlight.
senses.whyCN: 追问一旦加重，平常的「问」就变成了「较量」，那束光也变成照人的聚光灯。

senses.title: Relating to formal questioning
senses.definition: of or about the formal process of questioning a person, with rules and records
senses.definitionCN: 关于按规矩提问、有记录可查的正式问询过程的
senses.example: The committee made an interrogatory review of his records.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会对他的档案做了一次质询式的审查。
senses.why: Once asking is set inside an institution, the tie to interroger, a formal questioner, becomes visible.
senses.whyCN: 一旦发问被放进制度之中，它与「正式提问者」的联系就显现出来。

senses.title: Expressive of doubt
senses.definition: showing that the speaker doubts or wants proof
senses.definitionCN: 显示出说话者怀疑、想要凭据的
senses.example: Her silence was more interrogatory than any question.
senses.exampleCN: 她的沉默比任何提问都更带疑问。
senses.why: A question carried in the face or in stillness still asks, so doubt shows without words.
senses.whyCN: 问题藏在神情与沉默里，同样是在发问，于是怀疑不必用字词也能显露。

senses.title: Pertaining to grammar
senses.titleCN: 疑问（式）的；语法上的疑问语气
senses.definition: belonging to the grammatical forms used to ask questions
senses.definitionCN: 属于用来提问的语法形式的
senses.example: English marks an interrogatory sentence with a rising tune.
senses.exampleCN: 英语用语调上扬来标示疑问句。
senses.why: Grammar gives the asking mood a name, and that name is built from the same root as this word.
senses.whyCN: 语法为发问的语气取了个名字，这个名字同样出自此词词根。

senses.title: A written list of legal questions
senses.definition: in civil actions, a written set of questions sent by one party for the other to answer under oath
senses.definitionCN: 在民事诉讼中，一方以书面形式提出、要对方宣誓答复的问题
senses.example: She answered twelve interrogatories before the hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 听证前她答复了十二项书面质询。
senses.why: Here the adjective becomes a noun, and the beam of light is fixed on paper as a written list.
senses.whyCN: 这里形容词转为名词，那束灯光落在了纸上，变成一份书面问题。

senses.title: A searching look
senses.titleCN: （书面语中的）探寻；质询性的神情
senses.definition: a piece of writing or a look that amounts to a demand for answers
senses.definitionCN: 能够等同于索要答案的书面文字或神情
senses.example: His letter was one long interrogatory.
senses.exampleCN: 他那封信就是一长串追问。
senses.why: Anything that seeks an answer can stand in for a question, so the noun also names looks and writings.
senses.whyCN: 任何索求答案之物都可代替一个问题，所以这个词也能指神情与文字。

intro.en: Interrogatory comes from Latin interrogare, to ask, from inter- and rogare, to ask or demand, carried into English through the legal and official Latin of medieval Europe.
intro.cn: interrogatory 源自拉丁语 interrogare（发问），由 inter- 与 rogare（询问、要求）构成，经中世纪欧洲的法律与公文拉丁语进入英语。

items.en: Rogare means to ask or demand, and interrogare means to question or cross-examine.
items.cn: rogare 意为询问、要求，interrogare 意为盘问、审问。

items.en: Law courts used interrogare with a written question or an accepted answer, as in juratus et interrogatus, sworn and questioned.
items.cn: 中世纪法庭用 interrogare 指书面提问或对方已作答复，如「已宣誓并受讯」的用法。

items.en: Interrogatoire carries the legal questioning senses onward.
items.cn: interrogatoire 把法律上的审问义继续传递下去。

items.en: The form interrogatorius is a late, scholarly piece of legal vocabulary rather than an early classical word.
items.cn: interrogatorius 属于较晚的书斋式法律用语，并非早期的古典常用词。

items.en: The adjective enters English as a legal and formal describing word.
items.cn: 这个形容词以法律与正式用语的身份进入英语。

items.en: Common-law procedure gives the noun its fixed sense of a written question or a set of written questions.
items.cn: 普通法程序赋予其名词形式固定的含义，即一项书面问题或一组书面问题。

note.en: Interrogatory shares its root with the asking verbs and nouns of the same family, and stands near plainer question words and legal process words.
note.cn: interrogatory 与同族中表示发问的动词、名词共享词根，也与普通疑问词和法律程序词相邻。

entries.definition: to question someone at length
entries.definitionCN: 审问；盘问

entries.definition: lengthy or formal questioning
entries.definitionCN: 审问；盘问的过程

entries.definition: of the form used to ask questions
entries.definitionCN: 疑问的；表疑问的

entries.definition: asking or showing doubt
entries.definitionCN: 质问的；带疑问的

entries.definition: eager to find things out
entries.definitionCN: 好问的；爱打听的

entries.definition: sworn spoken testimony taken in question and answer
entries.definitionCN: 宣誓作证的笔录（法律）

normalIntro.en: Interrogatory is the asking adjective of the interroge word family: the same question runs through interrogate, interrogation, and interrogative.
normalIntro.cn: interrogatory 是这一词族中表示「发问」的形容词：同一个「问」贯穿 interrogate、interrogation 与 interrogative。

normal.en: The Latin root rogare means to ask, which also underlies abrogate, to cancel a law by decree.
normal.cn: 拉丁词根 rogare 意为询问，它也在 abrogate（以命令废止法律）一词之中。

normal.en: The suffix -ory forms adjectives of character and tendency, as in obligatory and explanatory.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ory 构成表性质与倾向的形容词，见于 obligatory 与 explanatory。

normal.en: In legal English the same word works as a noun, always plural in practice, as in serve interrogatories.
normal.cn: 在法律英语中同一词形也作名词，实际多用复数，如送达书面质询的搭配。

normal.en: Compare interrogative: interrogative is the grammar label, interrogatory is the tone or the legal paper.
normal.cn: 对比 interrogative：后者是语法标签，前者多指语气或法律文书。

normal.en: Keep the stress on the fourth syllable: in-TER-ro-ga-to-ry has the heavy beat before the -ry.
normal.cn: 重音落在倒数第三个音节：in-TER-ro-ga-to-ry，重拍在结尾 -ry 之前。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp held up to a face, light pinning the person in place.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯举到脸前，光把那个人钉在原处。

abstract.en: Imagine a row of question marks lined up like a fence.
abstract.cn: 想象一排问号排成栅栏的样子。

abstract.en: Think of a form with blank lines, each one waiting for an answer.
abstract.cn: 想一想一张满是横线的表格，每一行都在等人填写答案。

examples.en: The judge frowned at his interrogatory remarks.
examples.cn: 法官对他质问式的言辞皱起了眉。

examples.en: The court served interrogatories on both sides.
examples.cn: 法院向双方送达了书面质询。

examples.en: She gave him an interrogatory look.
examples.cn: 她投去一个带着疑问的眼神。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特-罗格-特瑞」——「罗格」像在「啰嗦」地追问，一路问到底就是质问；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语前缀 inter-（在……之间）+ rogare（询问、要求）→ interrogare（盘问）→ 晚期法律拉丁语 interrogatorius → 英语 interrogatory，核心义「执着地问」。

sensesIntro.en: Interrogatory starts with the plain sense of carrying a question, hardens into a probing challenge, settles into formal and grammatical questioning, and then becomes a noun naming legal lists and searching looks.
sensesIntro.cn: interrogatory 从「带着问题」的普通义出发，加重为逼问式的质问，再固定为正式问询与语法疑问，最后转为名词，指法律上的书面质询与探寻的目光。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a beam of light held straight at the face being questioned.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束光直对着被问的人的脸。

branches.en: Expressing a question is the plainest sense of the adjective.
branches.cn: 表示疑问是这个词最朴素的义项。

branches.en: Forceful probing and open doubt both press the question back at the other person.
branches.cn: 逼问与怀疑都把问题推向对方。

branches.en: Formal questioning and grammar both give the ask a fixed form.
branches.cn: 正式问询与语法都给「问」一个固定的形式。

branches.en: The legal noun is the same asking light frozen into a written list.
branches.cn: 法律名词就是把这束光冻成了一份书面清单。

branches.en: A searching look is the question asked without words.
branches.cn: 探寻的目光是没有字词的提问。

intro.en: Interrogatory is built from the prefix inter-, the root rogare, and the adjective suffix -ory, and gives the whole interrogate family to English.
intro.cn: interrogatory 由前缀 inter-、词根 rogare 与形容词后缀 -ory 构成，并为英语带来 interrogate 一整个词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin rogare means to ask, and interrogare means to question or cross-examine.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rogare 意为询问，interrogare 意为盘问、审问。

items.example: The prefix inter- appears in intercourse and interplay.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 inter- 见于交际与互动等词。

items.example: Rogare supplies the asking root of the family.
items.exampleCN: rogare 提供这一词族的核心词根。

items.example: The suffix -ory forms adjectives such as obligatory.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ory 构成 obligatory 这类形容词。

items.example: Interrogate is the verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: interrogate 是该词族的动词。

items.example: Interrogation names the process itself.
items.exampleCN: interrogation 命名整个过程。

items.example: Interrogator adds an agent suffix to the verb.
items.exampleCN: interrogator 在动词后加表施动者的词尾。

items.example: Interrogative is the grammar label.
items.exampleCN: interrogative 属于语法用语。

items.example: Interrogatory carries both the tone and the paper.
items.exampleCN: interrogatory 兼顾语气与文书。

items.meaning: a set of written legal questions
items.example: Interrogatories is the everyday plural in court practice.
items.exampleCN: interrogatories 是法庭实务中常用的复数。

items.example: Abrogate keeps the same asking root in a legal sense.
items.exampleCN: abrogate 在法律义中保留同一词根。
